### 14.8 Complete history retirement candidates

Refine D14 over the complete actual normalized group/frontier registry. Validate
group identity, known journal kinds, complete participant scopes and consistent
undo/redo placement. Every valid linked group appears once in every participant
scope in one direction; invalid groups are absent from active frontiers. Unknown,
duplicate or partial inventories refuse, not empty. This does not re-prove inverse
or mapping correctness.

The top of each stack is last. Add dependency edges from each higher entry to the
lower entry that can be reached only after traversing it, in undo and redo stacks.
Retiring a middle entry closes the unreachable prefix below it. Shared group
identities propagate through all linked scopes. Merge complete current host-supplied
additional retention dependencies; adjacency does not discover every mapping,
snapshot or admitted-operation obligation. Cycles close finitely as complete sets.

Current facts include per-group retirement permission, protected group identities
and frontier promises. A reference floor names scope/direction and a through-group,
protecting the complete top-connected segment including that group. Pins are sets
of protected identities, not a physical pin-owner count. If the least closed seed
superset intersects a pin/promise or lacks any affected group's permission, refuse
the whole retirement. Do not select only visible participants or weaken a promise.

Owned preparation captures immutable intent, complete history/retention basis,
recipient/profile and validated finite limits. Final candidate construction checks
that basis, current grants/coverage/pins/promises, reservations and resources again.
Preserve unrelated latest source/comments/versions/views/bindings, not a prepared
old root. Empty validated retirement changes nothing and needs no unused counter.
Nonempty retirement removes complete groups and every frontier reference in one
publication generation. Return its matching retention companion with incident
additional edges and retired permission entries removed. Real installation must
publish root and companion coherently through the existing authority.

Bound registry/root/participants/journals, frontier entries, graph edges, seeds,
pins/floors, closure node/edge steps, owned plan and complete candidate frame.
Exhaustion refuses without partial removal. Logical history retirement is not
content deletion, physical reclamation, snapshot discharge or producer cancellation.
Retained-absent membership still needs its separate retirement checks. Native
installation, weak-journal transfer and actual pin/permission/coverage truth remain
gates; this helper adds no second writable root interface or native job kind.

[Scoped evidence](formal/history-retirement.md) includes 32,768 actual-registry
three-group closure cases against an independent closed-superset oracle, 42 native
annotation/undo/redo states and ninety gate checks. Surviving journal rows remain
identical; each retained frontier is the original frontier filtered by surviving
group identity, not rebuilt history. A separate source-only paired exploration
compares actual reversal availability, complete document/version frames and those
frontier/journal relations before and after retirement: 108 history states, 864
candidates, 1,962 explored states and 6,576 reversal attempts, with depth six and
frontier/source-signature deduplication. Eighteen controls/eighteen mutants follow
a passing baseline. Conditional least-fixed-point and source-only preservation
arguments are authored evidence, not machine-checked induction or unbounded
all-kind reversal equivalence; annotation/native/install/lifetime gates remain.
The finite group-set powerset and its closed subsets have the stated lattice laws;
this does not prove whole-engine categorical completeness. Reuse PATH-04,
INS-01/02/03/06/08/12 and IF-03/12: MELT, RED/USE/golden distinguish preparation,
blocked capacity/promises, candidates, actual installation and real reclamation;
STRIDE/LINDDUN cover forged/partial plans, stale inventories, premature release and
private dependency/pin linkage without raw graph/content labels. Public routing,
real reservations/global/physical accounting, installed telemetry, full native
retirement/invocation/results/events, production/concurrency and independent
assurance remain. No numeric default, automatic eviction trigger, public verb or
whole D14/F14/all-sections closure is selected.

## 15 Literal search and atomic replacement

Requirements §5.6 governs the headless shared search service under IF-05/03,
PATH-07/01. Required v1 behavior is literal document/selection search, ordered
next/previous navigation, replace-current and atomic replace-all. No parsing,
regex, workspace discovery or semantic rename service is required.

### 15.1 Search request and result relation

A request binds document incarnation/source revision, literal query, matching
profile, captured scope ranges and request generation. Navigation additionally
identifies direction, start and wrap policy. Changing query/profile/scope/context
supersedes old work. Preview/navigation selections do not redefine the captured
scope or enter source history.

The mandatory baseline matches exact case-sensitive literal content without
normalizing source/query or treating line endings as interchangeable. An empty
query has no matches and cannot create zero-width replace-all. Literal replacement
has no capture substitution or executable expansion. Caseless matching, when
advertised, needs D18's pinned Unicode folding/mapping profile; optional smart-case,
locale, canonical-equivalence and word/identifier policies cannot appear implicitly.

For a nonempty query, consider matches wholly inside each allowed contiguous
scope and at valid source boundaries. Normalize overlapping scopes so a match is
not duplicated; never concatenate disjoint scopes to manufacture a match. Choose
deterministic leftmost nonoverlapping matches in document order. Navigation in
either direction traverses that same match set. §28.17 adopts exact start/current-
match inclusion and explicit wrapping; an observed wrap cannot create an
unbounded navigation cycle.

Matches retain exact original byte ranges across storage chunks and supported
fold expansions. Fold expansion cannot produce a partial-source-character match;
painted glyph bounds cannot widen a replacement range. Mixed-language/prose/fence
text is searched normally; lexical spelling matches imply no symbol identity.

### 15.2 Bounded work and replacement

Results distinguish pending, complete within declared scope, partial/truncated,
unsupported, superseded, cancelled and resource-exhausted states. A partial count
is not an exact total. Bound input/traversal, match/output storage, retention and
highlight work. Pure stale results may be discarded; current release still follows
§12 and query text is not default telemetry or implicitly persisted history.

Replace-current validates the selected occurrence/revision/profile and enters
the ordinary exact-edit contract. Replace-all requires one complete result set
from one snapshot, constructs one nonoverlapping change set and validates all
read-only, authority, revision, scope and capacity predicates. It publishes all
replacements as one local transaction and one undo group or none. Do not skip
read-only matches, publish a truncated prefix or silently turn resource pressure
into a different partial/batched operation. Superseded results require an explicit
fresh validated plan; they are not an automatic source rebase.

Cancelling search may restore a safely mapped origin selection under its profile,
never old document contents or somebody else's focus. A genuine empty/no-change
replacement result follows adopted D01 (§6.4), not a fabricated publication.

### 15.3 Conformance and observations

Reference tests cover chunk boundaries, overlapping occurrences, disjoint scopes,
empty query, literal special characters, mixed endings, supported fold expansion,
navigation wrap, stale results, read-only matches, partial/resource-exhausted work
and replacement atomicity/history. Existing edit algebra supports parts of change
application, not the complete search/matching/Unicode implementation.

INS-05/01/02/06 separate query/queue/service/result acceptance, useful versus stale
work, current application and history. Measure complete/partial/unknown coverage
and amplification without exposing query text/source/ranges as labels. STRIDE
includes malformed or adversarial inputs, stale replacement and floods; LINDDUN
includes search history, counts and hidden annotation/selection disclosures.

### 15.4 Owned native literal-search and replacement products

F05's literal-matches, next-match and previous-match products bind an opaque read
context, exact document incarnation/source revision, literal query, matching
profile, captured scopes and request generation. Navigation also binds byte start,
optional current-match identity and explicit wrap (false after defaulting).
Match identity is local to that result, not a transferable index into newer work.
The selected mandatory profile is exact case-sensitive literal UTF-8 without
normalization. Adjacent independently captured selection ranges remain separate
under §28.45; overlap normalization does not authorize joining selection boundaries.

Products distinguish complete-within-scope from known subset, unsupported,
superseded, unavailable and exhausted. Exact totals and exact navigation require
a complete set; a partial set carries no exact total. Logical budgets cover root,
scope, input, query, comparison, match, reply and replacement/edit bytes. Actual
async pending/cancel/retention products remain governed by §§12/17/23, not proved
by a synchronous reference evaluator. Release rechecks current recipient/purpose/
destination/captured ceilings; a selector or match is not write authority.

F11 replace-current binds a selected owned occurrence; replace-all binds the full
owned complete set. Both bind literal replacement and invocation identity, prepare
exact expected-byte edits and preserve source/annotation-set dependencies. Current
eligibility must cover every selected match. Publication uses the ordinary compound
coordinator, maps current annotations, and creates one linked source undo group or
none. Neither copied match payloads, stale query generations, partial replace-all
nor skipping read-only matches is an alternative admission path. Fully identical
effects use D01; equal source bytes alone do not establish companion identity.

[The scoped reference](formal/literal-search.md) composes actual source reads,
navigation, publication and inverse/forward reversal. It checks 3,168 finite
matching-oracle cases, 64 release combinations, 64 navigation compositions,
53 controls and seven mutants. Its logical inventory is not wire/Rust encoding.
Section 6.5.2.3 separately supplies selected decoded replacement composition.
Context issuance, actual policy/async lifetime/physical accounting, native decoding,
complete public replay/outcome/event products, optional folding and full implementation/companion
refinement remain gates. Point-profile persistence is unchanged.

#### 15.4.1 Retained source context and search evaluation

The selected synchronous reference path obtains its source only from the selected
F02 retained context, not a second independently supplied snapshot. It requires an
active source-bearing context with matching captured document, recipient, purpose,
destination, policy, continuity and profile, and exact-true current source-release
facts. An annotation-only context supplies no source or query grant. Existing
version-set membership requires a separately validated parent permit; one member
lookup cannot establish whole-set currency.

Bounded-copy the complete native request, current source facts, current query facts
and query limits before evaluation. Use the actual F05 declaration for its existing
fields/contract/operations, and normalize scope rows as exact numeric byte ranges
before native sorting. A safe data copy alone does not establish semantic shape.
The six native current-query predicates remain separate exact-true requirements;
do not reconstruct a matching current request from source-read permission. Intersect
root, input and reply limits with captured source-profile ceilings. Native exact
revision, matching profile, scope, navigation and completeness checks still apply.

The serialized functional registry remains identical on success and refusal. This
evaluation does not issue selectors, acquire/release holds, refund issuance, or
persist an authority-loss observation. Closed or invalidated contexts deny later
evaluation; explicit holds retain retired roots until discharge. A prior returned
result can still occupy memory after context retirement: owned identity and measured
reply bytes are neither query authority nor permission for later F11/F12 use.

[Retained-context composition evidence](formal/read-search-composition.md) covers
six direct native cases, 54 denials, six observer-capture/read-context/native cases,
nine exact packet boundaries, version-set independent-access/stop refusal and
eleven semantic mutants. Native issuer/authority-root binding, absorbing bound loss,
asynchronous child-result lifetime, actual policy and physical/global/concurrent/
crash/public/independent refinement remain separate gates. INS-05/01/02/06 retain
capture/admission/evaluation/release/use observations without sensitive labels or
new authority. No public request shape, verb, profile, job or default is added.

#### 15.4.2 Native retained result ownership and dependent consumers

The selected synchronous native path connects §12.8.4's actual current-source
owner to all three existing F05 query variants. A private pool binds that owner,
domain and source pool. Reserve its finite envelope against local limits and
actual parent headroom before evaluation; bound result count, lifetime issuance,
copy nodes/depth, request/capture/selector bytes and existing search work limits.
Input workspace is independent of retained-result count, including zero.
Logical reservations do not establish physical/global allocation bounds.

Require original opaque source identity, exact bound scope and separately accepted
source and current-query facts. Bounded-copy and validate the complete request,
current packet and numeric scope rows before observing loss. Intersect root/input/
reply ceilings with the captured source profile. Reserve an actual source hold
before evaluation. Known unpublished refusal discharges that hold but does not
refund spent source issuance. A successful returned result owns its hold until
protected retirement; later source publication alone cannot refresh its capture.

For an authentic bound result, exact-false query grant/scope/continuity/retention/
stop loss is absorbing. Unknown/truthy facts and transient capacity refusal deny
without establishing loss. Query loss does not close an independent source reader.
Actual source stop, disposal or owner fault fences dependent release under
§§12.8.4/12.9. Foreign scope, copied identities and changed current requests cannot
poison another result. Host identity/policy/interpretation and loss notification
remain separate accepted premises, not consequences of matching labels.

Selected decoded F11 replacement and F12 match-selection consumers validate the
original managed result owner before preparation and again at actual invocation
service. Prepared argument/intent and reply reservations do not grant an independent
read-context lease. Loss refuses new preparation or settles pending work as
`notApplied`, preserving the current root. It neither cancels the invocation nor
refunds its charges. Current write/view/companion checks remain separately required;
no requery, new scope or newer root repairs the original request.

Protected result retirement requires owner control, released retention and drained
delivery, independently of content grants. Discharge the source hold once and
remove lower-level capture, occurrence, rebinding and returned-footprint lookup
paths. Do not erase values still retained by a prepared invocation or refund that
invocation's obligations. Result-row removal does not refund fixed pool capacity
or lifetime issuance; empty-pool retirement refunds its reservation once and cannot
reset the issuer by reopening. No secure-erasure or physical-reclamation claim follows.

[Native search ownership evidence](formal/native-source-search.md) records twelve
controls, eighteen strict-fact denials, eighteen boundary cases, 21 semantic
mutants, actual disposal, protected registry retirement and dependent F11/F12
consumer checks. Seven-action exploration covers 2,801 traces/10,738 edges through
horizon four with three mutants, not unbounded induction. INS-01/03/05/06/08/13
separate capture, evaluation, release, current use, loss and protected discharge;
logical charge saturation/issuance exhaustion are bounded signals, not content
labels or proof of policy. No network I/O, UI policy or public pool/pin/lease verb
is introduced. Async scheduling, other required F02 issuers, complete public
products, host/physical/concurrent/crash and independent refinement remain gates.

#### 15.4.3 Combined context search ownership

The same engine-owned synchronous F05 service accepts original current source-only
or combined source/annotation contexts. A closed first-party issuer sum resolves
each original context in the actual owner/domain registry. Neither a caller-supplied
issuer label nor a provider callback chooses ownership. The actual pool recognized
when opening the service is bootstrap metadata, not later query authority or a
service mode; its retirement does not invalidate unrelated contexts.

Each result privately retains its original issuer and lease. Combined contexts
require current authority for both admitted classes and the captured facet domain,
even though search evaluates source. Annotation-only contexts grant no search
authority. Reserve a real combined-context hold before evaluation; its count and
metadata bytes are bounded independently, and issuance shares the context/selector
pool's nonrefunding ceiling. Add maxHolds times the selector-plus-record byte
envelope to the existing installed-context reservation before opening the pool.
These are declared logical units, not measured physical allocations.

Source-only and combined results may coexist. Stop or loss for one issuer cannot
retire another issuer's hold. A held stopped context cannot retire before its last
result discharges. Protected result retirement resolves the original issuer, drops
the hold once and preserves spent issuance. Preparation-pool retirement is separate
from installed context and search-result retention. Disposal or actual owner fault
fences delivery even under stale positive host facts; protected cleanup still
requires owner control, released retention and drained delivery, not renewed reads.

Section 15.4.2's F11/F12 current-use checks apply to both issuers before preparation
and at invocation service. Prepared arguments/replies create no independent lease.
[Combined search evidence](formal/native-combined-search.md) covers eight ownership
controls, eighteen exact-boundary cases, two actual disposal/fault cases, eighteen
protected denials, eighteen ownership mutations and twelve dependent consumer
cases with seven mutations for each issuer. No new verb, wire shape, transport,
frontend mode or numeric default follows. INS-01/03/05/06/08/13 observe acquisition,
evaluation, release, current use and protected discharge without source, selectors
or identity labels. Historical/version-set issuers, async protocols, complete
public products and host/measurement/physical/global/concurrent/crash/independent
gates remain. No new unbounded or categorical completeness proof is claimed.

#### 15.4.4 Decoded synchronous search facade

Both existing engine routes decode the three F05 literal-search/1 operations into
one captured meaning. Require exact outer routing and argument fields, declared
contract and operation/variant agreement; reject malformed scalar text, numeric
scope/navigation shapes, extra fields, accessors, cycles and unsupported data
prototypes without invoking data getters. Preserve literal spelling, scope order,
unsupported profile names and well-shaped stale navigation for native evaluation.
The original read-context identity is opaque and separate from copied data. It
must not be traversed, cloned or replaced by matching labels. This is an in-process
facade, not a byte decoder, transport or hostile-Proxy containment claim.

Capture the seven-field authority frame and require the existing actual authority/
engine domain binding. Source recipient/purpose/destination/policy/continuity and
read profile remain bound by the original context owner; the execution profile,
source-read profile and literal-matching profile are not interchangeable. Capture
the current query request, its original opaque identity, current-query facts,
source scope and current host facts independently. Do not repair any of them from
the command, promote unknown facts or replace current facts with captured grants.
Existing native validation determines agreement and authority. For a recognized
bound request, source loss remains observable before query-capacity or host-resource
refusal. Malformed or foreign input must not poison another context.

Before bounded copying, reserve a finite classification frame for the exact three
input-limit fields and eight maximum-sized logical workspace frames against actual
parent headroom. The maximum is the minimum of supplied maxRequestBytes and the
owner's maxIntentBytes; independently enforce node and depth ceilings. The eight
frames cover envelope, authority, canonical record, limits, normalized descriptor,
current/facts packet, producer request and restored current request. This explicit
conservative reference accounting is not a production numeric default or a physical
allocation bound. Refusal spends no native search/context identity. Hold the
workspace through the synchronous native query; reject reentry, refund exactly
that workspace in a protected finally path and fence the owner on a surprise.
Do not refund any returned result's separate native hold or spent issuance.

For requirements §§5.6/7.6, one complete admitted synchronous query is one
cooperative cancellation quantum. Validate current notStopped and the original
context before evaluation. The finite source/scope/query/comparison/match/copy/reply
bounds cover the whole call; chunkBytes alone is not an interrupt checkpoint.
No owner-control transition interleaves inside this non-reentrant call. A stop
accepted before it prevents evaluation; a request arriving during it can be
accepted at the next owner boundary, not retroactively interrupt the scan or
recall its already returned bytes. Protected context stop fences subsequent
queries. Later retained-result release and dependent F11/F12 preparation/service
must revalidate their original context and current notStopped facts; observed
bound result stop remains absorbing. Stop does not discharge retained holds.
An unprocessed host cancellation request is not an accepted stop or proof of
quiescence. Hosts must service protected control between quanta and choose finite
work profiles consistent with their supported responsiveness; actual service and
measured latency remain evidence gates, not consequences of a logical comparison
limit. No new F18 ticket, asynchronous query mode or mid-native preemption is
required for this selected synchronous profile. Any separately advertised async
search must additionally satisfy the existing pending/cancellation/late-delivery
contracts; this clarification does not prove that implementation.

The existing single native service still resolves source, combined and coherent-set
issuers, including supported original-parent retained copies. Its returned products,
current-use checks and protected retirement remain unchanged. Dependent F11/F12
preparation and service must still validate the original managed result. No new
verb, invocation ticket, queue, asynchronous mode, UI binding or substrate mechanism
is introduced. IF-01/02/05, PATH-02/07 and INS-01/03/05/06/08/13 distinguish decode
refusal, workspace admission/refund, evaluation, native retention and current use;
record bounded dispositions/units, not content or opaque identities as labels.

[Decoded search evidence](formal/search-gateway.md) supplies exact boundary,
mutation, fixed fault/reentry, selected substrate and current/retained issuer
composition checks. Complete public result/event/selector discovery, asynchronous
lifetimes, actual host/policy truth, physical/global/concurrent/crash refinement
and independent assurance remain gates. No unbounded or categorical closure follows.

### 15.5 Owned occurrence selection and current replacement companions

F05 match rows deliver exact lo/hi and a scoped owned occurrence reference. It
binds the result's exact source incarnation/revision, query/profile/scopes and
generation, not a caller-supplied range. Cache at most one reference per retained
match and include it in the bounded result envelope. Issuance/lookup is part of
existing result construction, not a new public verb. Reference possession is not
authority or a read lease. Known partial occurrences remain selectable without
claiming an exact total, complete navigation or wrap; empty queries have none.

F12 selection-edit/1's select-search-match adds match, explicit forward/backward
direction, before/after affinity, and replace-all/replace-primary/add-primary mode.
Validate both current search context and exact view/source/selection context again
at publication. Foreign or stale occurrence identities do not retarget a current
document, and no implicit source rebase or new search repairs them. A normalized
view selection may merge with existing ranges under §26.1.1; this never changes
the captured search scope or original replacement extent. Selecting readable
read-only source grants no source mutation authority or authored history.

F11 replacement now stages the current owner annotation set and all required
current view participants under the shared bounded positional-view machinery.
The source dependency remains the query snapshot. A later annotation change can
use fresh preparation without rerunning unchanged source search; a post-preparation
change refuses the stale plan. Current membership/profile/source/selection/version
and work limits protect complete source/annotation/view publication. No peer is
silently skipped or old viewport restored. Replace-all remains complete-set only.

Equal-byte view effects are distinct from source/annotation identity: validated
selection change publishes once without a source revision or source undo group;
complete identity preserves the current root. Section 6.4.1 separately composes
equal-byte annotation mapping; other profiles remain gates. Empty edits require no view-map inventory by construction,
not because absent membership is assumed empty for a nonempty transform.

[Owned search/view evidence](formal/search-selection.md) composes actual F05/F12/F11
and shared view helpers: 36 selection cases, 32,768 final gate combinations, six
replacement forms, 42 controls/eight mutants. Native encodings/issuance, actual
policy/retention/concurrent release, full movement/Unicode/geometry, all companions,
replay/outcomes/events and physical refinement remain gates. No global UI default
or point-storage policy is selected.

## 16 File fidelity and save coordination

Requirements §§5.4/5.9–5.10/7.4/10 govern IF-04/13, PATH-05 and INV-10/11/13.
Local edit publication is not file persistence. Source and separately persisted
annotations retain their own capture, modified-state and outcome dimensions.

### 16.1 Strict UTF8 import and serialization

The required file profile accepts strict UTF-8 with reversible leading BOM
metadata. A consumed signature is not a document character or edit offset.
Preserve the loaded BOM choice, exact newline sequences—including mixed LF/CRLF,
lone CR and final-newline absence—and whitespace. Invalid/unsupported/ambiguous
decoding fails on a staged candidate without replacing live content, rebinding
an owner or destroying history/comments. Lossy import, if exposed, is a separately
labeled conversion, never a silent replacement-character lossless open.

Generated newlines use the explicit insertion policy: LF for new documents unless
the host supplies another policy. Literal insertion/paste remains literal under
its contract. Explicit newline/normalization cleanup is a validated text operation
with mapped companions and history. Output encoding/BOM settings have their own
generation and can change intended output without changing source revision.
Other encodings are optional advertised host profiles, not binary editing or
automatic codec discovery.

The native v1 document profile records a closed LF/CRLF/CR default at birth.
Compatibility creation/load explicitly select LF; host-aware creation/load accept
an explicit default and catalog-backed source activation consumes the captured read
row's default. Alias joining preserves the existing owner unchanged, including its
default, rather than applying the incoming policy. Do not infer a policy from mixed
source endings. The exact-current-version default query and document-default
newline facade reuse existing source/view validation and bounded explicit newline
derivation, mapped companions, publication and history. Explicit/configured
delimiter requests and literal edits keep their separate contracts. The default
is immutable in this native profile; no setter, independent policy generation or
new command/wire variant is implied. Undo/redo and Save As do not alter it.

For each claimed lossless profile and captured metadata, encoding unchanged decoded
input must reproduce its bytes; decoding encodable text must reproduce that text.
Unsupported/unrepresentable output rejects before destructive dispatch, never
substitutes/drops content or switches encoding. File-byte, document-byte, parser
and persisted annotation coordinates require explicit profile/version conversion.
Scalar UTF-8 VCs are not a complete BOM/stream/optional-codec implementation proof.

The BOM/text inverse domain needs explicit treatment of a literal leading U+FEFF:
`(BOM present, text x)` and `(BOM absent, text U+FEFF followed by x)` encode to
the same UTF-8 bytes. A decoder that automatically consumes the leading signature
cannot reconstruct both tuples without declared context or a narrowed domain.
§28.21 selects one-signature import and rejects the ambiguous absent-BOM output
tuple in the base profile. Do not silently drop a literal character or assert a
universal two-sided metadata/text inverse outside that declared domain.

### 16.1.1 Bounded streaming source and serialization products

strict-utf8-one-bom/1 specifies the codec/capture portions of F20/F21, not a whole
resource request, public wire ABI or filesystem integration. source-codec.json
closes normalized contexts, serialization/capture fields, limits and nine UTF-8
control states. Validate actual dense octet arrays without numeric coercion;
reject overlong, surrogate, out-of-range and truncated encodings. Preserve valid
NUL, noncharacters, literal U+FFFD, whitespace and all source newline sequences.

Bind staged input to origin/provider/resource identity, binding generation,
opaque version epoch/token and profile under current authorized/coherent-read
premises. Each chunk names the exact next sequence/raw-file offset. Wrong context,
gap, duplicate or extra fields refuses without advancing; invalid bytes/exhaustion
terminally fail processing. Retain an initial at-most-three-octet signature probe
across chunks. Consume exactly one leading EF BB BF into metadata; flush a
nonmatching or incomplete probe into strict scalar validation. Only scalar-start
accepts EOF. Completed finish returns the same owned candidate idempotently;
failed, aborted or retired streams cannot publish one. Staging performs no source,
binding, history or annotation mutation and does not attest provider quiescence.

Capture serialized output from the actual expected document/source and independent
serialization generation, whose normalized record contains profile and BOM choice.
Own immutable source/settings/output. Prepend one signature iff metadata requests
it; refuse absent-BOM plus literal leading U+FEFF without modifying either source
or settings. Current recipient gates govern candidate inspection, mapping and
bounded serialized payload reads. Import positions map exact scalar boundaries
by the captured 0/3-byte prefix; consumed signature interiors have no document
coordinate. Raw output payload chunks may split scalars/signatures and are never
text edit positions. No normalization/conversion is implicit.

Exact byte comparison names both captured source/settings versions; equal length,
digest, revision or settings generation is not equality. Actual source publication
and undo can produce equal output at fresh revisions, while BOM-only settings
changes can change output without a text revision. No comparison elects a saved
baseline or proves external freshness, acknowledgment, durability or annotation
save success. Complete destination/binding/effect/receipt capture remains separate.

Bound active streams/artifacts, total issued refs, aggregate logical held bytes,
context/input/source/output/chunk/candidate/artifact/reply bytes, chunk count,
comparison work and coordinates. Empty chunks count. Reserve import retention
before processing; abort disables use without refund, and safe codec retirement
does not recycle issuance. Output capture is immutable and independently retained.
These are normalized logical caps, not physical decoder/allocator accounting or
protection against arbitrary hostile in-process objects.

[Codec evidence](formal/source-codec.md) contains construction/induction arguments,
2,304 byte/control transitions, nine EOF states, 65,810 raw cases, 9,195 chunk splits/
9,195 coordinate positions, 512 import/128 capture/128 release gate masks, 43 controls
and twenty semantic mutants, with an independent native fatal-decoder oracle and
actual source publication/undo. It does not prove actual coherent resource reads/
tokens, full F20/F21/F27 admission/replay/events, atomic load publication, all
companions, optional codecs, real policy/retention, filesystem guarantees,
production/physical refinement or independent Cleanroom certification. INS-04/07/
08/03/01/02/06/13 observe validation/capture/release/retention and later effects;
MELT/golden/RED/USE count useful complete candidates/output separately from partial
bytes, with STRIDE/LINDDUN treatment and no content/path/token/ID metric labels.

### 16.1.2 Owned source resource read work

resource-read/1 specifies the source-load-candidate variant of F20 and selected
F27 streaming receipts under source-resource-read-reference/1. Capture actual
registration/provider/resource/origin, expected generation, identity domain/key,
locator, codec, supported read guarantee and generated-newline policy. At admission
and final submission recheck current grants, identity/coverage, continuity/liveness/
stop, provider availability and bounded resources. Preserve captures and never
substitute whichever resource later occupies a locator. Identity knowledge,
availability, ownership access and read permission remain distinct.

captured-read identifies a coherent received byte bundle; it does not claim a
single physical file revision, current external freshness or non-ABA versioning.
atomic-resource-snapshot requires declared capability and a trusted matching
attestation. Start/end token equality alone cannot upgrade the guarantee. Real
provider snapshot, identity and attestation truth remain explicit host premises.

Accept only authentic permitted bounded exact task/origin/provider/resource
start/chunk/end/failure/quiescence envelopes. Start fixes attributed resource
version/coherence; ordered chunks use exact sequence/file offset; end repeats that
context and exact chunk/byte counts. Validate bounded counters/octet shape before
duplicate/conflict classification; malformed authenticated data cannot manufacture
a trusted contradiction. Compose the actual §16.1.1 codec. Only valid
EOF yields a candidate; malformed source/capacity refusal does not publish partial
source or imply an engine defect. Exact duplicates are idempotent. Known conflicts
retain the original transcript and bounded witnesses, disable applicability and
prevent an uncontested baseline. A third distinct witness or full transcript
explicitly refuses as evidence-full; no arbitrary-union lattice claim follows.

Cancel/supersede stops candidate use, not submitted execution. New pure chunks may
be discarded after stop, without claiming they were decoded; retain the specified
terminal facts and contradictions. Ready stopped work never launched and can
release its work reservation. Submitted work requires separate authentic attested
quiescence; EOF, failure, wait cutoff or caller stop is insufficient. Quiescence
releases only work and may precede buffered ordered receipts. Retained codec/
transcript/baseline holds and delivery drain remain separate retirement gates.

Preflight capture/completion/context capacity and compatible private codec profiles
before dispatch. Bound tasks/outstanding/ever-issued origins, captures/envelopes/
transcripts/witnesses, held logical bytes/decoder reservation and registry scans;
§11.2.1 separately checks document/binding/root activation capacity. Safe retirement
cannot recycle origin issuance or discard the record backing an active created
binding. These are logical units, not physical accounting or a fairness theorem.

The [reference evidence](formal/resource-read.md) covers the source read/initial
activation path, not annotation-load, full F17/F20/F27 public schemas, actual
filesystem/provider truth, source replacement/reload, write admission, invocation/
replay/events, production concurrent installation/all companions or independent
Cleanroom certification. INS-04/07/08/02/01/03/09/13 distinguish received/decoded/
candidate/created-or-joined milestones, candidate refusal, contradiction, stopped
work, quiescence/drain and pinned evidence. MELT/golden/RED/USE use local monotonic
stage clocks and safe bounded counts; STRIDE/LINDDUN cover identity/role confusion,
stale/forged receipts, guarantee promotion, exhaustion and owner-existence linkage.

### 16.1.3 Owned source-load operation admission and matching retry

The selected normalized load-command profile uses the existing native reader
as the owning operation issuer and sole retry owner. An operation identity is
qualified by that actual issuer incarnation and complete original context, not
by an origin string alone. The first successful native admission atomically
creates its parent-operation record and actual child task. The record binds
the original context, complete immutable request and child identity. This is
not a borrowed core publication invocation or an authored-root transition.
The profile has one native effect attempt per parent and no automatic provider
retry. A changed effect/attempt label cannot authorize another child. A separately
authorized new logical read has a new operation identity and re-enters all current
admission checks; it is not matching retry or recovery of the old operation.
Cross-issuer deduplication and automatic retry/reconciliation are not advertised.
No homogeneous global issuer, dispatcher or execution mode is required.

The parent control abstraction is closed; payloads and identifiers are separately
bounded, not finite by assertion:

| Parent state | Input | Transition |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Absent | Valid first request, no raw history, all current admission and capacity guards | Atomically install owned parent and ready child; otherwise remain absent. |
| Owned child | Matching complete request and current release | Observe the same child without dispatch or state change. |
| Owned child | Changed intent/effect/attempt, or raw admission | Refuse without another child. Native service/evidence/control keep their existing independent transitions. |
| Owned child | Guarded native child retirement | Retire both co-owned roles and retain the spent parent tombstone. |
| Retired parent | Any repeat or relabeled attempt | Refuse; this state never becomes absent. |

Each normalized call performs bounded map/record work and, for fresh admission,
a scan of at most maxIssued bounded raw-origin keys; no recursion, hidden I/O or
host callback is added. This is not a worker-termination or wall-clock guarantee.

The precedent is caller request identity plus an owned immutable-intent record
and atomic resource admission, as described in the
[Amazon Builders' Library](https://aws.amazon.com/builders-library/making-retries-safe-with-idempotent-APIs/).
This reference adopts local serialized ownership, not that source's distributed
durability or response-replay guarantees. Operation-specific result disclosure
still follows the selected retained-outcome facet, not original-command replay.

The normalized F20 source-load-candidate binding reuses resource-read/1 and its
actual native reader; it adds no issuer, owner, provider procedure or local
publication job. Typed family/variant/version/arguments and dynamic
name/variant/version/arguments envelopes select the same catalog entry/version.
Unknown fields, versions, routes, other variants and invalid native arguments
refuse before admission. These reference envelopes are not a wire format or a
hostile decoder. Full dynamic schema/discovery integration remains separate.

Before any current-fact read, bound the complete request plus execution context
by maxCaptureBytes and privately capture both. Native lookup, fresh admission and
parent installation use that same private semantic input. Outer catalog routing
does not read permission suppliers or confer authority; strict permission checks
remain in the owning native path after capture. A supplier that changes the
caller's original request or context cannot retarget either the child or its
parent. This normalized in-process rule is not a hostile-object decoder or a
physical/transient-allocation proof.

Qualify operation/effect/attempt by the actual reader incarnation and the complete
original domain context: authority, engine, recipient, purpose, destination,
profile and continuity. Compare that scope before lookup. Current authorized,
scope, continuous, live, notStopped, readAllowed, retained, replyReady,
transferReady and resourcesReady facts must be strictly true for delivery.
Neither possession of an origin string nor another issuer's inert handle marker
is authority. Actual policy/identity truth remains a trusted supplier premise.

For a previously unowned operation, use existing native admission: its serialized section
compares duplicates, checks the ordinary fence and current actual root, captures
the request/registration and reserves the native task and bounded parent record.
Any prior raw attempt with that operation label refuses rather than being adopted
as a parent after the fact. Raw admission also refuses another child under an
already owned parent. Admission does not submit
the read, contact a provider, publish content or activate a candidate. For a
owned parent, look up by operation independently of effect/attempt and compare
the complete immutable native request. A matching live
record returns that exact task with observe-existing; changed intent or an origin
whose task retired returns unavailable. Do not recapture a registration, allocate
another task, submit the producer or change an attempt label during recovery.

Matching delivery is not fresh admission: it may survive an ordinary admission
fence and missing launch/provider readiness under the current release gates.
It cannot reset a stopped task or claim completion, cancellation or quiescence.
Native service/evidence/control/retirement keep their existing separate contracts.
The consumed-origin set remains bounded by lifetime issuance; retiring a live
slot does not remove its spent origin or make the old identity fresh. In addition
to maxHeldBytes for live native task payloads, reserve
2 × maxIssued × maxCaptureBytes in the actual parent: one independent lifetime
envelope for spent origin keys and one for owned parent records. Each encoded
origin key is smaller than its bounded complete request; the complete
[operation, parent-record] capsule must fit maxCaptureBytes before installation.
The latter includes original scope, request, actual task and a prepaid retirement
tombstone. Both store counts are at most lifetime native issuance. Guarded child
retirement replaces the co-owned parent payload with that tombstone in the same
serialized transition, not a separate consumer pin or an eligibility reset.
The safe-integer product and combined reservation must fit before owner attachment;
overflow or insufficient parent capacity refuses without installing the owner.
Keep this reservation after task retirement; zero live-task heldBytes is not zero
owner replay storage. This is a conservative serialized logical bound, not measured
allocation or total physical owner cost. The reply
must fit the existing reserved maxEnvelopeBytes before either response. Matching
comparison scans only bounded retained native tasks and creates no new owner state.

RES-SPENT-ORIGIN-STEP checks the lifetime-byte induction under the per-key bound,
safe combined reservation and non-reusable issuance premises; the initial spent
count/bytes are zero. RES-SPENT-ORIGIN-OMITTED-CONTROL exhibits the reproduced
payload-only underfunding. Apply the same conditional induction separately to
the bounded parent store; summing its independent reservation with the origin
reservation and live envelope gives the combined bound. The JavaScript guards
check the factor-two product and sum before owner attachment. Both use the
existing resource-profile SMT manifest;
they do not prove the JavaScript compiler, byte-size bridge or physical allocator.

Thirteen controls and sixteen targeted guard mutations check this selected relation,
with a passing copied native-graph baseline before mutations. Separate read-only
challenge found no concrete defect at this scope. This is not provider dispatch,
terminal receipt/F19/effect-event assembly, hostile ingress, physical/concurrent/
crash refinement, whole F20/L02 closure or independent certification. INS-01/03/04/13
distinguish new admission, matching observation, refused release, provider dispatch
and retained obligations. A recovered task is not another logical admission or
provider attempt; unavailable is not proof of nonapplication. Existing bounded
MELT/golden/RED/USE signals retain STRIDE/LINDDUN protections; raw origins, resource
locators, scopes and content are not telemetry labels. No measurement schema is added.

### 16.1.4 Owned annotation-load operation admission and matching retry

The same qualified identity, atomic parent/child admission and single-attempt
policy and pre-fact bounded private input capture in §16.1.3 apply to the actual native annotation reader. Its confined
ledger owns the original parent record; raw admission cannot create another
attempt under that parent or retroactively adopt an earlier raw attempt.

The normalized F20 annotation-load-candidate counterpart uses the same closed
typed/dynamic envelope shapes and catalog version as §16.1.3, but the existing
annotation-resource-read/1 arguments and actual native annotation reader. It
does not accept a source reader, raw registry, copied marker or supplied root as
that owner. Pure argument validation is shared with fresh annotation admission;
it checks shape/versions/profile, origin, document/provider/resource roles,
numeric expectations, read guarantee and bounded request size without inspecting
current document versions or regenerating a candidate.

Bind the complete original domain context before looking into the native owner's
confined actual ledger. Current native release gates and readAllowed,
transferReady and resourcesReady must be strictly true; annotationReadable remains
independent of source/resource access. A matching consumed-origin request returns
the exact retained task. Changed source/set/pair/binding/registration expectations
are changed intent, not a request to refresh it. A retired origin stays spent.
Fresh admission alone enters the existing serialized native admission section,
actual-root/current-binding checks and ordinary fence. The task-reference reply
must fit maxEnvelopeBytes before either response.

Original-task observation is not current candidate applicability. A real source
edit may make the old candidate ineligible for inspection/restoration while the
original task remains retrievable under current permission. Neither matching
lookup, ordinary fencing nor stopping that task submits it again, restores content,
reclassifies its historic capture or adopts a baseline. Candidate release,
initial restoration, baseline adoption, late evidence, quiescence and retained
producer retirement keep their existing independent contracts. Original task
identity is not permission to disclose private records or snapshot bytes.

As for the source reader, reserve validated safe maxHeldBytes plus
2 × maxIssued × maxCaptureBytes in the actual parent before attaching the native
annotation reader. Lifetime origin keys remain after task payloads retire. The
same conditional RES-SPENT-ORIGIN-STEP law and omission counterexample apply to
this store; no additional proof mechanism or numeric production default follows.
An actual baseline counterexample retained 898,432 origin-key bytes beyond a
760,000-byte task envelope after 128 admission/stop/retire cycles. These are
reference witness parameters, not memory measurements or recommended limits.

Twelve controls/sixteen guard mutations check both routes before submission and after
a real source change, exact task/scope/intent, strict release, ordinary fencing,
non-reusable retirement, retained parent funding and clean invalid/overflow
refusal. Copied native graph baselines pass before mutations; separate bounded
review found no concrete defect. Full F20 discovery, provider dispatch, terminal
receipt/F19/event assembly, host truth, hostile ingress, physical/concurrent/crash
refinement and independent certification remain outside this selected relation.
INS-01/03/04/07/13 distinguish retries, refused delivery, native read milestones,
restoration and retained responsibility using the existing minimized measurement
contracts. Lookup is not another logical admission or provider attempt; no raw
origin, resource identity, document content or scope is a telemetry label.

### 16.1.5 Owned ordinary-save operation admission and matching retry

F21's normalized typed/dynamic bindings reuse the actual shared destination writer
for captured-source-save and captured-annotation-save. The source arguments are
the existing source-save/1 request. Annotation arguments are exactly request,
context and binding: the existing annotation-save/1 request, complete annotation
serialization context and standard identity/source-association binding. Actual
writer/domain, reservation pool and technical work profiles are trusted host
bindings, not payload-selected authority. Closed envelope/version/variant and
native argument validation refuse unsupported inputs before admission. Bound and
privately capture the complete semantic input and execution scope before reading
current fact suppliers; later caller mutation cannot retarget the captured child
or change the parent record's meaning. Codec/capture and parent installation use
that same private input, not a later reread of caller-owned records.

The shared writer is the owning issuer and sole retry owner. Its operation
namespace is writer-incarnation-qualified across attached domains; the owned
record additionally binds the actual original domain and complete execution
context. One operation owns one native effect attempt; no automatic retry or
cross-issuer deduplication is advertised. Look up the operation independently of
effect/attempt, compare complete immutable intent and release only the original
task under strict current scope/continuity/liveness, write permission, appropriate
source/annotation disclosure, disposition, retention and reply/transfer/resource
facts. Changed request, annotation context/binding, domain, effect or attempt
refuses. Prior raw work cannot become a parent admission retroactively; raw
ordinary/export entry cannot add another attempt to an owned parent.

First source admission seals the parent capsule with the existing native
ordinary-admit preparation. Final token read/commit rechecks parent eligibility
and installs the owned parent and actual serialized child together. First
annotation admission validates the standard artifact, retains its complete
original context/binding and creates its parent in the existing codec/writer/
baseline-claim admission section. Refusal does not spend an origin, publish a
ticket or leave a claim/preparation behind. Existing distinct ordinary
destinations, one document owner, captured versions, FIFO and baseline rules
remain unchanged. No authored-root publication is inferred from save admission.

Matching lookup neither recaptures current content nor reinterprets aliases.
It does not migrate an existing claim to a replacement pool or use replacement
technical limits to re-encode the capture. It may survive an ordinary admission
fence and unavailable launch/preparation facts under current permitted disclosure.
Returning an existing task is admission metadata, not terminal result replay,
provider dispatch, storage acknowledgment, baseline adoption or quiescence.
Operation-specific result delivery retains §23.1.10's selected retained-outcome
principle; this binding adds no receipt kind or terminal-result route.

The absent/owned/retired parent FSM in §16.1.3 applies. Guarded native child
retirement spends its co-owned parent and drops payload into a prepaid tombstone.
An annotation baseline reservation/claim must actually discharge separately;
retentionReleased alone cannot waive it. Unknown/dispatched writes keep their
existing reconciliation, disposition and quiescence duties, even after stop.
A new logical save uses a new operation identity and all ordinary capture/
condition/dispatch guards; relabeling cannot replay an uncertain old write.

Before installation, the complete [operation, parent-record] capsule, including
execution scope, semantic intent, domain/task roles and retirement tombstone,
must fit maxCaptureBytes. The shared writer sponsor reserves an independent
maxIssued × maxCaptureBytes lifetime parent-store envelope in addition to live
tasks/codec, spent origin/fault keys and existing metadata. This shared node is
funded once, not per domain edge, and not refunded by individual task retirement.
Safe arithmetic and the conditional resource-store induction apply; no physical
allocation or concurrent/crash atomicity is asserted.

Eleven controls/fifteen coherent-graph mutations cover both routes, original intent,
raw bypass/adoption, real claim release, retirement, aggregate bounds and funding,
and admission versus storage evidence. Bounded read-only review found no concrete
defect in this selected relation. Full qualification, complete discovery,
provider/receipt/event/control assembly and whole F21/L02 remain separate.
IF-01/02/04/08 and INS-01/03/04/07/13 retain admission, permitted observation,
dispatch, storage evidence and retained-responsibility distinctions. Use existing
bounded MELT/golden/RED/USE populations and STRIDE/LINDDUN protections; no raw
operation, destination, scope, alias or content becomes a telemetry label. No
UI, concrete substrate procedure, network hop or measurement schema is added.

### 16.2 Capture and provider guarantees

A save captures immutable source/annotation content, document incarnation and
revision, serialization profile/settings generation, binding/destination generation,
original baseline evidence, operation/effect/attempt identity and required
acknowledgment strength. Encoding is prepared/validated before destructive write.
Later source/settings changes cannot alter the capture or relabel it as latest.

The ordinary reference integration uses agreed best-effort external-change checks,
not universal atomic conditional writes. Check available baseline evidence before
saving; detected conflict or missing evidence required by the chosen guarantee
blocks normal overwrite and preserves unsaved state. Atomic replacement and
check-then-write do not isolate arbitrary external writers. A stronger required
guarantee must match advertised provider capability or be rejected before dispatch;
normal saving is not rejected merely because a stronger optional capability is absent.

The provider contract declares resource identity/continuity, replacement visibility,
write/completion/quiescence/unknown evidence, synchronization/acknowledgment strength
and attribute/security preservation. Synchronization is enabled by default where
supported under the agreed ordinary procedure; a stronger requested strength
cannot silently degrade. D07/D15 select actual reference-host profiles, not a
universal rename/fsync or crash-recovery guarantee.

Declare token capabilities independently: equality validation, atomic conditional
write, non-reuse within a stated identity/retention epoch, and attested write order.
One capability does not imply the others. Opaque validators are not ordered
counters; a reused content validator cannot prove absence of an intervening write.
Any causal token-chain inference needs the corresponding non-ABA/provider validity
contract. D07/D15/D16 must state the supported evidence, not assume all ordinary
providers offer these stronger capabilities.

### 16.2.1 Native annotation storage artifact capture

Capture the complete current live annotation inventory from the actual managed
authority root, under the original normalized context, document incarnation,
source revision and annotation-set generation. Validate the actual activated
membership inventory; unknown/legacy state is not empty. Require current complete
read/export disclosure, aliases, source evidence, retention, transfer and reserved
preparation. Write authority or a filtered F03 result is not a complete storage
capture grant. These current host facts remain separately supplied evidence.

Use explicit bounded host document/record/source association tables. Native live
records and needed source revisions have complete unique mappings; source-context
aliases are not inferred paths, stream references, ETags or ordered validators.
Current source bytes match the actual root. Historical authored source evidence
requires its own current trusted supplier, not inference from present placement.
Missing, conflicting, noninjective or out-of-budget required evidence refuses the
whole capture rather than inventing identity, repairing targets or dropping records.

Preserve every supported live record's identity/incarnation, body/version, target
generation, authored source/target and attached/affected/detached placement in the
§29.4.1 shape. Both point profiles/affinities survive explicitly. Check targets
against their selected source's scalar boundaries; located placements bind current
source. Retained-absent records, tombstones and history are not live-file rows.
No source body is exported by this annotation format. Alias/history truth is not
proved by syntactic validity or matching length.

Generate owned immutable UTF-8 JSON bytes and validate them with the strict
snapshot reference before delivery. Check complete artifact/reply bounds in
addition to native input/table/membership/snapshot limits. No partial artifact,
root mutation, invocation execution or provider write occurs. The private copied
basis remains historical after later edits; it grants no write/restoration rights.
Raw delivered bytes are disclosure, not a revocable lease. Provider dispatch and
retirement retain their independent actual policy/ownership/evidence gates.

[Scoped native evidence](formal/annotation-artifact.md) includes 150 captures,
8,192 gate cases, seven context checks, three source-history stages, ten controls/
eleven mutants with passing baseline and conditional preservation/finite-scan
arguments. Existing solver totals stay 223/thirteen manifests. INS-01/03/06/07/08/12
and MELT/RED/USE/golden signals distinguish complete output from refusal, unavailable
evidence and preparation pressure; STRIDE/LINDDUN challenge alias/profile tampering,
stale bases, partial exports and private linkability without raw identity labels.
Actual host alias/policy/historical truth, shared physical accounting, production
streaming, native restoration/migration, provider writes/receipts/baselines,
concurrency and independent refinement remain. No new public acquisition verb,
provider service, hash protocol or all-sections closure is selected.

### 16.2.2 Retained annotation artifacts and bounded byte release

### 16.3 FIFO admission and final dispatch

All engine-mediated writes share single-flight coordination per host-resolved
destination identity, not per workspace, spelling alias or serialization profile.
Admitted saves retain exact captures in bounded FIFO. Exhausted capacity rejects
before admission; Busy is a modeled alternative, not the selected ordinary queue
policy. Do not coalesce undispatched saves or discard their capture silently.
Independent destinations and local edits may continue while one destination blocks.

Before dispatch, validate current launch authority, binding/provider context,
guarantees, applicable original/derived conditions and reservations. Frozen content
does not freeze write permission. A newer source revision alone does not invalidate
an explicitly captured older save or authorize replacing its payload. A failed
launch leaves the capture undispatched with its explicit disposition and releases
only safely releasable obligations.

The adopted queued-baseline direction (§28.16) preserves original capture and
preconditions while recording any derived dispatch condition separately through
attributable uncontested preceding writes. It cannot relax explicitly pinned
caller preconditions, use unknown/contradictory evidence or blindly refresh tokens.
D16 retains actual provider validity/schema/refinement gates; the draft does not treat a convenient
new token as evidence that the caller authorized a new overwrite.

Retain canonical knowledge plus two conflicting witnesses, with explicit refusal
of another distinct witness. This finite store is not arbitrary-union lattice closure.

Written bytes, requested acknowledgment, safe effect disposition and worker
quiescence remain distinct. A synchronization failure does not erase a write.

### 16.4 Evidence and safe disposition

| Milestone or observation | Required interpretation |
|---|---|
| Queued and never dispatched | Work remains local; accepted cancellation/expiry can end it and release its work reservation under the chosen profile |
| Dispatched | External effect may exist; caller cancellation/deadline does not prove it stopped or release its unresolved single-flight obligation |
| Progress or cancellation acknowledgment | Retain authenticated attributable facts, but do not infer completed write, safe retry or quiescence from a weaker claim |
| Trusted safe-disposition evidence | May release the specified unresolved effect obligation under the provider contract; quiescence alone is not successful persistence |
| Write succeeded but required synchronization failed | Retain both facts and report the unsatisfied guarantee; do not claim no write occurred, that the required acknowledgment was met, or that replay is automatically safe |
| Late/duplicate historical receipt | Match exact effect/attempt/source/profile/binding and evidence strength; retain valid facts without redirecting them to a new binding/revision |
| Contradictory authoritative receipts | Preserve contradiction and require fault/reconciliation handling; never choose last-message-wins or an uncontested saved baseline |

One declared retry owner uses bounded attempts and an actual safe replay basis:
known nonapplication, supported dedup/idempotency or conditional-effect protection.
Unknown writes block incompatible retry/rebind/new dispatch until the contract's
safe disposition is established. Restarting a worker, ending wait, losing an
observer or dropping telemetry does not establish that disposition.

### 16.5 Saved state and baseline attribution

Keep at least intended-output comparison, external freshness/conflict, save-control
state, retained outcome evidence and acknowledgment strength separate. A current
binding baseline identifies loaded/acknowledged serialized content/profile/token.
Compare intended output under a bounded equality contract to report unchanged,
modified, unbound or not-yet-established equality. Digest equality needs a declared
collision/assurance policy; it is not silently exact byte equality.

Undo can return to equal serialized output at a fresh revision. An older receipt
still names the older revision and procedure, not the newer one whose bytes happen
to match. Current-binding attribution and uncontested order evidence determine
baseline eligibility. Receipt arrival order, maximum text revision or a reusable
opaque equality token cannot establish physical write order or unique freshness.
Do not let an old duplicate regress a newer eligible acknowledgment.

When relevant ordering evidence is missing, retain the acknowledged candidates
and unresolved attempts without inventing a unique latest outcome. An antichain
is one possible internal representation, not a required public type. A multi-file
or combined source/annotation save reports each captured resource/artifact outcome,
including unknown, and retains enough operation context for explicit safe retry
or reconciliation. It claims joint atomic persistence only under an actual host
capability; compensation after partial writes is not atomicity. Do not automatically
reverse live authored state or overwrite later unrelated edits to mask a partial
external failure.

An acknowledged baseline is historical evidence, not proof of current external
contents, absence of unresolved attempts, crash durability or recovery. Optional
force overwrite/reload/save-elsewhere actions are explicit separately authorized
operations, not automatic conflict retries. File watching, auto merge and recovery
remain outside v1.

### 16.5.1 Causal source-save continuity and historical baseline publication

source-save-continuity-reference/1 extends §16.3.1's owned source path with the
explicit own-chain policy, separate causal receipts, acknowledged-write anchors,
current-binding baseline publication and exact current-output comparison. It does
not change the pinned policy or authorize another destination/provider/payload.
Original captures and conditions remain immutable. Declare causalReceipts and
nonReuseTokens independently of conditionalWrite/syncSupported and establish their
actual identity/validity-epoch contract. No ordinary filesystem provider is assumed
to offer these optional capabilities. A causal receipt attests actual before/after
write versions, not an earlier best-effort probe; authentic exact capture/schema
and independent causal attestation precede comparison. Incompatible result/edge
facts fault the destination in either arrival order. Repeated equal facts are
idempotent; the existing capped witness store remains explicit, not union closure.

Derive only from the original verified anchor through retained later own dispatched
writes for the exact document/binding/registration/procedure. Skip known safely
resolved nonapplication. Each written edge requires known application, no-future-
effect disposition, uncontested matching result/causal versions, both capabilities,
current progression permission, a matching head and different token in the same
epoch. Unknowns, gaps, ABA, epoch changes and conflicting facts refuse advancement.
Record bounded origin/serial/before/after edges and derived condition separately;
the final attested destination probe must match that condition. Preflight the
expanded receipt envelope and counter before actual dispatch. No token refresh,
implicit retry or stronger external isolation is inferred.
Before admission, reserve the minimum expanded receipt with worst-width dispatch
serial/initial condition and any required initial derivation space. A profile
fitting only the older receipt shape refuses before artifact issuance; later
additional edges still require final capacity checks.

Assign a fresh private serial only at actual launch. Under the per-destination
known-application/no-future-effect barrier, an earlier own attempt cannot write
after a later own launch. This supplies order among this coordinator's writes,
not arbitrary external-write order or current disk freshness. An explicit serialized
baseline publication rechecks current authority/coverage/companions/resources,
actual binding/registration and unique owner, then selects the newest eligible own
acknowledgment for that context. Eligibility requires full written application,
captured requested strength and uncontested evidence. Newer source revision or
receipt arrival never wins by itself. A newer synchronization-failed write remains
known written but unqualified; an older eligible baseline is still historical,
not a claim that no newer write occurred.

Extract exact bytes from the private immutable codec artifact. Baseline fields
identify captured source/settings/binding, profile/BOM, origin/provider/procedure,
qualified/required acknowledgment, optional version and dispatch serial. Publish
only sourceBaseline plus one safe publication-counter advance, preserving current
authored state and all other companions. Equal metadata is unchanged. Late older
receipts cannot regress a newer eligible baseline; stopped writes may still have
historical acknowledgments. Old bindings/disposed targets cannot acquire it.
Later contradiction excludes eligibility without reverting root history/source.

Verify acknowledged anchors against actual private tickets and exact artifact bytes.
An earlier tokenless acknowledgment remains valid historical byte evidence even
after a version is learned; explicit publication may record that attributable new
fact. A missing version cannot authorize another version-conditioned save. An
internal current-output projection requires current source/comparison/binding/
retention/resource authority, exact baseline evidence and bounded temporary actual
serialization. Compare exact octets within the combined limit, preserving current
and baseline version identities and external freshness not-established. A fresh
revision may compare equal; ambiguous/unavailable serialization is not guessed or
repaired. Retire the temporary region without changing the root or spending the
persistent writer's issuance. Complete public F02/F06 projection remains a gate;
this internal reference does not invent a new public verb.

Retirement rechecks the actual current serialized root in addition to effect/work/
retention/drain obligations. Current producing baselines and nonstopped queued
captures with older/equal anchors pin required written records. A newer root baseline
cannot erase edges needed by an older queued capture. Unknown/contested records
do not retire by stop; exhausted capacity backpressures. Bound derivation, baseline
materialization, comparison, envelope and root work independently. Host truth,
actual concurrent installation, physical costs and hold transfer remain refinements.

[Continuity evidence](formal/source-save-continuity.md) includes 4,096 publication/
2,048 comparison cases, all 24 receipt-order permutations, 27 controls/twenty
semantic mutants and authored conditional arguments. Actual provider causality/
non-reuse/atomicity/durability, supported host profiles, annotation/combined saves,
retry/reconciliation/rebind/SaveAs, complete invocation/replay/events/all companions,
hostile decoding, physical/concurrent/production and independent refinement remain
gates. INS-04/07/08/13/03 and INS-02 observe chain refusal, acknowledged versus
unresolved effects, baseline publication/equality, protected release and held floors;
do not label telemetry with source, paths, identities or tokens.

### 16.5.2 Exact retained annotation output comparison

For trusted normalized inputs, compare two owned native annotation artifacts
through the existing codec, without
electing a saved baseline or choosing ordinary source/annotation binding policy.
Each operand needs its own full original context/document/source/set basis and
independent exact-true current disclosure, retention, transfer, resource, reply
and comparison facts. Source-read permission is not required or a substitute.
Foreign/cloned/source/retired/stopped operands refuse. Restrict this helper to one
document incarnation and identical normalized contexts; independent operand grants
do not establish a new cross-context correlation contract.

Source/set versions may differ across historical operands but cannot be refreshed
or substituted within either basis. Bound comparison by the sum of both complete
byte lengths. Compare actual stored bytes, not bodies, lengths, generation tuples,
digests or JSON equivalence. Return equal/different and copied historical source/
set/byte-length metadata under the complete reply bound, without bodies or a
discrepancy offset. Do not change native roots, artifacts, ledgers, issuance or stop
state. Equal bodies after undo need not imply identical versioned snapshot bytes.

[Scoped evidence](formal/annotation-comparison.md) covers 42 native capture/undo/
redo cases, 8,192 per-operand release decisions, twenty basis negatives, ten controls/
twelve mutants with passing baseline and conditional arguments. It does not exhaust

witness where static capture bounds already dominate the small reply.
Reuse INS-01/03/07/08/12 and PATH-05 for permitted/refused comparison work, bytes,
latency and retained occupancy separately from saves. MELT, RED/USE/golden and
STRIDE/LINDDUN cover wrong kinds, cross-context correlation, one-sided grants,
stale bases and quota/equality linkage without raw content/basis/identity labels.
Comparison proves no saved baseline, write acknowledgment, external freshness,

global/physical accounting, production/concurrency and independent assurance remain.
No public query/transport or whole D20/F21/all-sections closure is selected.

### 16.5.3 Acknowledged annotation baselines

Apply §16.5.1's historical-evidence policy to actual native annotation artifacts.
Admission of an explicit annotation export may privately capture its complete
ordinary annotation binding only when the current pair, typed owner and full
registration validate under §16.2.4. An export without that association remains
an export; a later binding cannot retrofit it. Keep the provider receipt's export
binding generation separate from the ordinary annotation binding generation.
Neither admission nor acknowledgment implicitly changes the document baseline.

Explicit baseline publication requires current exact-true authority, scope,
continuity, lifecycle, complete binding/writer/baseline coverage, historical
artifact access, companion, reply and resource facts. Revalidate the complete
current ordinary pair, exact original annotation binding, unique typed owner and
whole captured registration. Missing initial baseline state requires explicit
absence attestation; a present corrupted baseline refuses rather than being
repaired. Select the newest eligible own dispatch serial for this binding, then
require its exact original annotation context. Do not fall back across contexts.
Known written application, captured acknowledgment strength and uncontested
evidence determine eligibility, not receipt arrival or annotation-set version.

Materialize exact retained artifact bytes under the baseline bound. Record
source/set versions, format, original context, origin, provider/procedure,
required/qualified acknowledgment, optional external version, dispatch serial
and both binding generations. Publish only annotationBaseline plus one safe
publication-counter advance under the complete root bound. Equal metadata is
unchanged and needs no unused generation. Preserve source, annotations, views,
source baseline and every other root field. A later token may enrich a tokenless
historical acknowledgment through another explicit publication. Contradiction
fences eligibility without reverting authored state or earlier root history.

An internal current-output comparison validates that baseline against its actual
private ticket/artifact, rechecks current annotation disclosure and comparison
authority, exact context and the complete native source/annotation state, then
captures bounded current output through the actual native producer. Compare
exact bytes within the combined operand budget; equal lengths, set versions,
JSON equivalence or equal bodies are not substitutes. Return only permitted
comparison metadata and external freshness not-established. A fresh set version
can yield identical empty output after undo/redo. Temporary comparison neither
mutates roots nor spends persistent writer/artifact issuance. No new public verb
or query protocol is selected.

Retirement checks current annotation bindings and explicitly retained binding
history as well as existing effect/work/drain obligations. A producing baseline
and a known written attempt still eligible for adoption pin their actual tickets
and artifacts. A newer qualified baseline may release older evidence, but cannot
release its own producer or a producer retained in binding history. Unknown
history and stale inventory generations are not discharge evidence. Missing
history uses this initial profile's empty-history convention; this does not prove
all future rebind/unbind/restoration routes.

[Scoped evidence](formal/annotation-baselines.md) covers 42 native cases, 8,192
publication and 32,768 comparison gate cases, 27 controls/27 assertion-detected
mutants and conditional arguments. Explicit exports may acknowledge a write
even when later independent baseline publication lacks capacity. An ordinary
annotation save promising baseline installation must reserve that obligation
