fencing. This does not implement complete factory fencing or the full shutdown
controller and does not extend the reference proof's assurance claim.

The selected first-party owner attachment relation is keyed by actual immutable
owner handles in the actual invocation domain. Its closed role vocabulary is
source/annotation readers, the shared writer, baseline reservations, source/
annotation/coherent capture and context pools, search, settings and settings reads,
serialization, registration bases/reads/events, discovery, history, analysis,
observation contexts/admission, diagnostic capture/drain and publication observers.
An inert marker identifies a role, not an authority. A role catalog is not proof
that every possible factory or dependency has been inventoried.

Acquisition reserves the complete declared additional child envelope and a positive
metadata frame before exposing an owner. The frame covers simultaneous pending
preparation, retained key/edge and one captured internal inventory representation,
using maximum encoded numeric widths. Parent-funded pools retain their existing
native charge; their attachment adds metadata, not a duplicate child ceiling.
Separately bounded registries reserve their declared ceiling in the parent as well.
Checked addition and actual parent headroom govern refusal. The original pending
lease and admission section control commit/abort; changed markers, copied leases,
foreign domains and duplicate actual edges cannot substitute. Predictable refusal
unwinds an uncommitted acquisition; an unexpectedly retained native pool remains
attached and funded rather than being labelled refunded.

The shared writer has one immutable actual-domain accounting sponsor for its
declared shared node. Later domain attachments fund their own edges without
duplicating the node reservation. One domain's fence, task retirement or edge
removal cannot release a peer's work or refund the shared node. This is not an
automatic sponsorship-transfer or whole-writer retirement contract. Ordinary
annotation ingress requires an actual funded binding. Failed provenance staging
does not select a sponsor. A genuine immutable historical root previously exposed
by an attached domain remains eligible for the existing source-save capture path,
subject to that domain's current admission state and all original capture guards;
a copied root is not such a witness. This private identity relation does not
retain historical roots or establish physical reclamation.

The absorbing fence applies to selected new obligations on existing owners, not
only constructors: read/analysis tasks, contexts, search results, capture cuts,
registration establishment and fresh settings/serialization bases or plans.
Returning an identical retained registration basis, an exact existing plan or
an existing write-baseline hold is service, not new issuance. Such lookup paths
retain their original authority/currentness checks and cannot allocate if a
previous hold disappears during fact capture. Existing settings visibility
preparation and registration resynchronization remain available for retained
consumers. Ordinary annotation-save baseline preparation, validation and commit
require the original actual-domain admission-section token through their confined
producer; no second lock or caller-selected operation is introduced.

Prepared source/annotation activation, generic disposal, rebind, membership and
catalog/container publication cannot cross the fence. Generic disposal is not
shutdown-consent acceptance. Qualified source/annotation baseline bookkeeping,
adoption of an already-restored read baseline, disposed binding/provenance
release, authenticated late evidence and protected cleanup remain subject to
their exact existing guards. Native root-installation sections exclude fence
installation through fact reads and commit, including exception unwind. Existing
issuer holds must discharge before their contexts/pools. Capture discharge facts
once per selected search retirement and recheck the original retained identities
after fact capture; recursive cleanup cannot decrement/refund the same hold twice
or turn an already-completed nested cleanup into an invariant fault.

Native publication observers derive roots from their actual domain. Original
caller binding precedes current-loss observation or packet consumption. Local
outcome summaries derive from an actual terminal invocation ticket with the
original correlation and a bounded copy; caller result/root claims and copied or
foreign tickets do not substitute. Unsupported rich producer facets are refused,
not reclassified for another audience. Stop and outcome retirement retain the
observer, original bindings and funding where no whole-owner retirement exists.

Internal inventory requires the original full domain context and strict protected
supervision. Its additional-child and metadata totals are not total native cost,
physical usage, arbitrary retained-report copies or a recipient disclosure surface.
Release follows actual native discharge and the original edge lease exactly once.
Unknown work, producer pins, nonrenewing issuance and owners without whole-owner
teardown remain owned; zero tasks or a stopped flag is not discharge. The selected
reference and mutation checks are described in [the owner attachment contract](formal/owner-attachments.md).
Complete factory/dependency closure, remaining preparation paths, shutdown consent/
controller composition, eligible service, public F18/F19 assembly and host/clock/
physical/independent assurance remain separate obligations.

IF-01/02/03/04/05 and INS-01/02/03/04/05/08/12/13 retain existing boundaries.
Observe offered/refused acquisition, parent pressure, actual retained owners and
protected-progress outcomes separately. Report native cost, additional child
funding and metadata distinctly; no private handle, origin, document or path becomes
a metric label. Bounded enums and aggregate resource counters support MELT,
golden signals and applicable RED/USE measures; no new network or UI layer follows.

### 17.5 Conformance and observations

Test mixed human/agent bursts, alias/tiny-request fan-out, expensive staging,
completion floods, unavailable drains, failed cancellation, clock invalidity,
shutdown under pressure and forged-versus-trusted contradictory messages.
Check telemetry on/off and recipient-private metrics. Existing execution/rank,
PS-SA/SC/SE/AC/DR/UP are scoped safety/conditional-progress evidence, not actual
allocator/native/provider or whole-scheduler refinement.

INS-01/04/05/08/12/13 separate offered/admitted/rejected/coalesced/superseded work,
useful completion, queue/service/pending age, real reservations and unknown effects.
Observe safety/control capacity and originating-scope amplification without identity
labels or private activity leakage. STRIDE includes quota/class spoofing, forged
completions, starvation and recursive monitoring floods; a diagnostic cannot bypass
ordinary validation or replace authoritative accounting.

## 18 Optional language service and mixed regions

Requirements §§6–6.2 govern derived analysis under IF-05/07, PATH-07/08 and
INV-03/04/07/15. The library supports incremental tree-sitter integration, but
ordinary editing must work with language support absent, malformed source, missing
grammars or incomplete analysis. Grammars/queries are pluggable host-controlled
assets, not source-controlled executable instructions.

Requirements §3.4.1 also governs optional structural/schema/domain providers for
prose, code and mixed documents. Their implementations and grammar/schema runtimes
are not authoritative core dependencies. Prefer established applicable standards
with named versions/dialects/extensions, distinguishing syntax, schema constraints
and domain meaning. The core accepts typed bounded targets/evidence/proposals,
not a mandatory universal AST, graph engine or interpretation implementation.
No new advanced structural operation or schema runtime is made mandatory in v1.
These optional schemas describe document content, not mandatory core operation-
envelope/type validation.
The supported tree-sitter and required host/child reference integration remain
integration gates outside the minimal core, not waived capabilities.

Where a supported operation promises structural/schema conformance, prepare
candidate evidence against its exact source/region and provider/profile versions,
then validate all declared dependencies at final publication. Do not run arbitrary
provider callbacks inside that boundary. Missing/stale/ambiguous/partial evidence
cannot authorize the stronger operation or silently downgrade its guarantee.
Ordinary editing of invalid/incomplete content stays available without those
providers. Line/token/structural targets resolve to the shared source-change path;
successful tokenization alone proves neither losslessness nor domain completeness.

### 18.1 Parser context and activation

A mutable parser/incremental working state has one executor owner at a time;
grammar and highlight-query assets are host-pluggable, not embedded as mandatory
parts of the authoritative editor core. A supported integration may bundle assets
under an explicit packaging/activation contract without making them core dependencies.
Accepted parse snapshots stay immutable. Do not create a parser per view by default;
views with an equal accepted analysis context may share results. Results bind
document incarnation/revision, analysis context, grammar/query generations and
relevant configuration, not merely text revision or permanent syntax-node identity.

Incremental input is the exact composed committed source transformation from the
parser's starting snapshot. Coalescing must preserve that meaning. If necessary
transformation history is unavailable, rebuild from an identified snapshot within
budget rather than invent missing edits. Query-only changes need not reparse a
still-valid tree; grammar replacement invalidates its dependent parse results.

Validate grammar/query/native-asset compatibility before atomic context activation.
Failed activation retains only a declared compatible last-known-good context or
explicit plain-text/degraded service under D24; never a partial mixed combination.
Loading native scanners is an explicit trusted-code capability. No implicit
downloads, document-specified paths or assumed native-crash sandbox are provided.

### 18.2 Result relation and bounds

Distinguish missing grammar, invalid query, partial/incomplete source analysis,
unsupported work, resource exhaustion, cancellation/supersession and worker fault.
Malformed source and incomplete trees remain editable data, not automatically an
operation-algebra fault. Current result acceptance revalidates all context; derived
evidence never directly publishes source mutations or establishes semantic discovery
completeness. Structural proposals reenter normal exact-source mapping/authority
validation and may report pending/unavailable analysis.

Parsing/query/highlight work is bounded, coalesced and demand-driven where safe.
A visible highlight query can require wider parse context; visible-only demand
does not prove parsing only those bytes correct. Syntax-tree changed ranges alone
do not establish complete highlight invalidation. Bound total snapshots, parser
instances, regions, depth, query fan-out and per-document aggregate work.

### 18.3 Mixed-language source mapping

One source owner/history applies across natural languages, markup and embedded
grammars. Region labels do not establish rights or new authorities. Tangling/export
that mutates another object is a separately declared participant/effect, not an
ownership transfer inferred from semantics.

The reference profile covers Markdown prose and multiple independent code/diagram
fences, including Mermaid labels. The host-controlled registry resolves supported
labels/aliases as data; labels cannot name commands, library paths, downloads or
grants. Independent fences remain separate child parses by default, even with the
same language label. General combined multi-fence, arbitrary discontinuous and
recursive injection plans remain excluded. Section 18.6's named within-one-fence
projection may exclude identified host continuation markers with exact maps; it
does not concatenate independent programs or authorize cross-hole child edits.

Discover regions from host structure and bounded registered rules; preserve exact
maps between every child result/proposal and authoritative document byte ranges.
Fence delimiters remain host-language syntax. D25 must define boundary/crossing
range policy and deterministic host/embedded highlight precedence before exposing
language-sensitive commands. Changing fences/labels/discovery configuration can
invalidate membership/maps/child results without large body changes; discovery-
query and highlight-query generations are distinct dependencies.

Unsupported labels/grammars, incomplete fences and exhausted region work use an
explicit fallback that preserves unrelated regions, host styling and normal edits.
One actual supported child grammar must demonstrate nested parsing/highlighting;
fallback-only output does not meet that required capability. D26 selects concrete
assets. Mermaid source parsing does not require diagram rendering, script execution,
external renderers or network retrieval.

### 18.4 Conformance and observations

Compare incremental parsing with fresh parsing under the same pinned profile;
this checks incremental consistency, not grammar semantic completeness. Test stale
grammar/query/context results, failed activation, multiple equal-label fences,
Mermaid fallback, fence/label edits, mixed-region source transactions, exact returned
byte maps and aggregate tiny-fence exhaustion. PS-DR/context gates remain partial
lifetime/acceptance evidence, not the grammar or complete region-discovery oracle.

INS-05/09 capture activation, queue/service/context acceptance, region fan-out,
partial coverage and fallback; no source/query/grammar path payloads or identity
labels by default. STRIDE includes incompatible/native assets, forged labels,
stale node/map use and query floods; LINDDUN includes source-derived relationships
and cross-context result reuse. Registered assets and language labels confer no
extra mutation, disclosure or scheduling authority.

### 18.5 Committed parser source bridge

tree-sitter-utf8-source/1 supplies the source-input portion of F24 preparation,
not full analysis-work admission or a grammar dependency in the core. Snapshots
name exact document incarnation, source revision and canonical UTF-8 bytes.
Parser rows advance only on LF and columns count bytes, independently of the
editor's LF/CRLF/CR logical lines. CRLF-interior scalar boundaries are representable
parser points; neither editor line conversion nor UTF-16/grapheme/display columns
may silently substitute. Preserve literal U+FEFF, mixed endings and all source bytes.
Respect the native uint32 byte/point domain without choosing the core integer width
or a measured file-size limit.

The actual reference source/annotation coordinator stages bounded optional journals
and associates owned committed transformation receipts with successful result roots.
Ordinary editing and current-view history carry the association through their
complete private view roots only when publication and source frames agree. A staged
token is not a committed receipt; it binds the exact candidate root and matching
source frames, and commits once. Multi-document publication retains separate source
receipts without splitting local publication. Undo/redo supply actual retained
forward/inverse sequences with fresh revisions, not reconstructed reverse diffs.

Explicit journal document/source/batch/edit/byte limits and reservation constrain
this optional evidence. Missing/exhausted journal preparation does not reject
otherwise valid ordinary editing. The later analysis must use a fresh identified
snapshot under its own capture/work admission, or report unavailable; no guessed
missing edits or unlimited fallback parsing. Aggregate/native retention and actual
ownership remain separate obligations from these serialized-byte/count bounds.

Parser input products are incremental, fresh or source-only unchanged. Preparation
requires current authority/read/continuity/liveness/stop/capture predicates and a
complete finite profile. An incremental chain must consist of owned same-document
receipts with exact contiguous revisions and before/intermediate/final bytes.
Copied, missing, duplicate, reordered or unrelated receipts cannot authorize it.
Equal bytes at a newer revision require their actual chain or fresh input, not
source identity. Source-only unchanged does not prove grammar/query/discovery/
configuration or full analysis freshness. Same-version conflicting bytes refuse.

For each canonical batch, process disjoint edits from highest original offset
downward. Produce TSInputEdit's start_byte, old_end_byte, new_end_byte and their
three exact LF/byte points in each then-current source. Bound intermediate sources,
receipt/batch/edit counts, native coordinates and complete plan JSON bytes. A
missing/incompatible/over-budget chain yields fresh source only if that product
independently fits. Invalid target bytes or unrepresentable output refuses without
rounding, normalization or a purported incremental success.

[Source bridge evidence](formal/parser-source.md) checks 930 point, 996 single-edit,
22,770 paired-edit, 27 three-publication and 64 capture-gate cases, 51 controls and
21 mutants through actual source/ordinary/F14 view-aware references. Prefix,
batch/chain induction and conditional point-inverse arguments explain the laws;
they do not prove native parser correctness. INS-02/07/05/09/01/03/08 cover committed
handoff, capture, input modes/fallback and resource/release boundaries. MELT/golden/
USE/RED and STRIDE/LINDDUN use bounded mode/reason/budget classes, not source,
positions or document/history IDs. Native parsing/tree ownership, grammar/assets,
regions/highlights, analysis F24/F28, all publication paths/companions and physical/
concurrent/independent implementation refinement remain explicit gates.

### 18.6 Pinned native language reference

pinned-markdown-javascript-reference/1 selects Tree-sitter 0.26.0, Markdown 0.5.4
block/inline and JavaScript 0.25.0 reference assets, all three native languages at
ABI 15. The tested verification tuple is CPython 3.13.11/darwin arm64, not an editor
runtime or supported host matrix. The manifest records publisher distribution
checksums and enforces installed native/wrapper/query/license fingerprints before
and after each worker, with a mismatch control. MIT notices are retained in the
verified distributions; production licensing/bundling/maintenance remains separate.
The Markdown upstream documents inaccuracies and a highlighting goal: do not
promote its packaged extension profile to an authoritative CommonMark validator.
No universal JavaScript/JSX semantic or grammar-conformance claim follows either.

Actual committed source inputs from §18.5 edit a copy of the accepted native tree,
then parse captured new bytes. Compare full named/anonymous/error/missing-node,
field/range/LF-point structure and lexical captures against fresh parsing under
the same language. Original trees/captures remain unchanged in the tested domain.
Malformed/incomplete source stays editable data. Observed equal-length identifier
changes can alter captures without syntax changed ranges, so the latter are not
a complete highlight invalidation oracle. Native invalid-query and query-only
controls do not replace the engine's atomic activation/current-context contract.

The block host tree supplies inline nodes and independent fence bodies. Parse
inline content excluding named host children, not meaningful anonymous punctuation.
Each fence uses its own child parse; js/javascript are registered ASCII-normalized
aliases. Unknown language/Mermaid, unavailable grammar, incomplete fence, empty
supported body and region-budget outcomes remain distinct. Do not execute labels,
download code, render diagrams or create new source owners/history.

Native included ranges retain original document bytes/points. Within a fence,
exclude identified host continuation prefixes as explicit source-map holes. Split
display captures around holes while preserving host syntax; derived contiguous
child edit targets crossing holes/fences refuse rather than clip or widen. This
does not constrain ordinary exact-byte authoring across language boundaries, and
does not complete the proposal/publication/current-result bridge. Source/label
changes rederive maps in the fresh comparisons; actual cached F24/F28 freshness
and sharing across views remain separate gates.

The reference display resolver gives child captures precedence inside admitted
ranges, then inline over block; shorter spans and lexicographically first capture
names break remaining ties. Host literal fallback and prefix ownership survive.
This is a semantic capture policy, not a theme or native paint proof. Explicitly
disable property-assertion query patterns absent their service: this lexical
profile excludes two JavaScript locals-dependent patterns and claims no locals
resolution. A document-wide child-analysis budget covers inline and fenced parses;
aliases/tiny fences cannot reset it. Exhaustion keeps host styling and explicit
partial/region-budget coverage, not complete child analysis.

[Native reference evidence](formal/tree-sitter-reference.md) executes 195
incremental/unchanged cases, one fresh case and 14 mixed-language cases, 32 controls,
one fingerprint control and 13 semantic mutants. Python sources join frozen input
capture; full verification requires the pinned native tool and 49 harness controls.
Signals, timeouts, import/C-API failures do not count as semantic mutation kills.
Verification caps/deadlines are not measured product defaults or native halting/
preemption/physical-accounting proofs. INS-09/05/01/03/08/10/11 cover assets,
parse/query/map/fallback, acceptance/release/resources and later presentation;
MELT/golden/USE/RED and STRIDE/LINDDUN avoid payload/label/path/hash/ID metric tags.
Full analysis admission, concurrent parser lifetime, incremental child reuse,
complete semantics, production ABI/packaging/frontend/host integration and
independent Cleanroom certification remain explicit gates.

### 18.7 Owned analysis work and current shared-view products

captured-analysis/1 refines F24, enabled-analysis-result in F28 and selected F08
products for the §18.6 reference language profile. analysis-work.json defines
exact normalized fields and finite limits; it is not a public wire/native ABI.
Capture the actual document/source and analysis/provider identities plus grammar,
highlight-query, discovery-query, registry and configuration generations. Require
current authorization, source/disclosure scope, continuity, liveness, stop and
capacity/reservation gates. parse-query uses §18.5's actual owned source bridge.
query-only requires a retained owned parse fact with exactly matching source
revision/bytes and parse dependencies; only highlight-query generation is separate.
Grammar/discovery/registry/configuration changes cannot masquerade as query-only
reuse. Missing journals allow independently bounded fresh input, not guessed diffs.

Revalidate capture at submission and acquire one mutable-parser lease per analysis
identity. Multiple bounded ready tasks and independent analysis identities are
allowed; this promises neither FIFO nor fairness. The host must refine the lease
into exclusive native parser use and correct immutable-tree copy/lifetime handling.
Cancellation/supersession disable applicability, not submitted execution. Only an
authentic correlated attested quiescence releases its work slot/lease. A result or
old duplicate quiescence cannot release a successor lease. Retained evidence/base
holds and delivery drain remain separate retirement obligations.

Intake authentic permitted result/failure/quiescence envelopes bound to the exact
task/provider/operation/effect/attempt. Retain at most two distinct terminal
witnesses; equal repeats are idempotent, a distinct second contests and invalidates
the parse fact and dependent snapshot chain, and a third distinct witness explicitly
refuses as evidence-full. This is not arbitrary-union lattice closure. Reject
unknown variants/fields and overbudget envelopes. Packet context/source must match
capture; region bodies/included ranges and captures must respect exact scalar byte
boundaries. Resolved captures are ordered nonoverlapping positive spans. Child
captures cannot cross host-prefix holes or escape parsed included ranges. Host
parse-state/child errors and partial coverage stay distinct from schema/domain truth.

Acceptance is separate from intake: recheck current authority, continuity/liveness/
stop, provider/context/source and valid owned base chain. Cancelled, superseded,
contested, stale or malformed work cannot become an accepted current snapshot.
A new accepted current result disables older query use; independently retained
immutable parse facts can survive cancellation/replacement for freshly authorized
reuse. A known contradiction invalidates those facts. Prevent producer retirement
while any retained task holds its snapshot as a base, including a cancelled child.

F08 supported-analysis takes an owned snapshot, actual attached view and bounded
scalar source range, returning resolved capture fragments clipped for display only.
supplied-evidence-inspection returns context, host parse state and coverage. Neither
returns an AST, grants edit authority, proves meaning or initiates parsing. Recheck
current recipient gates, actual source/context/base validity and view attachment at
every read; matching views share the same accepted snapshot without owning source
or mutable parsers. Other semantic-provider products remain separately specified.

Validate finite task/outstanding/issued-origin/aggregate held-byte, capture/envelope/
source, region/range/aggregate capture/tag and query/reply limits. The logical task
charge reserves capture plus three envelope capacities for two terminal witnesses
and an accepted packet copy. Quiescence does not refund retained charge; retirement
does not recycle spent origins. Normalized logical charging is not physical heap/
decoder/native accounting. No missing quiescence is assumed eventually delivered.

[Evidence and conditional trace arguments](formal/analysis-work.md) include all
14 actual native mixed packets, 512 admission/512 submission/128 acceptance/128
release cases, 87 controls and twenty semantic mutants. The accepted reference
stores observations, not actual native tree identities: actual native base binding,
parser ownership/concurrent lifetime, child reuse, host authentication/policy/roots,
physical retention/decoder limits, full invocation/events/companions and production
refinement remain gates. INS-09/02/07/01/05/03/08/10/11 cover context/capture/lease/
work/evidence/quiescence/current release/retirement and later presentation. Count
useful current deliveries separately from stale/cancelled/partial work; track lease
wait, missing quiescence and retained-base saturation. MELT/golden/RED/USE and
STRIDE/LINDDUN use protected correlation and no content/label/path/ID metric tags.

### 18.8 Live native base binding and handle lifetime

native-analysis-binding-reference/1 composes §18.7's actual analysis owner with
the pinned §18.6 native environment. A private verification-host session binds
the specific accepted snapshot to its producing task and retained native forest.
Session-local handles are never recycled or exposed by F08. Equal source/context
does not authorize substitution of another session's native tree. Exact engine
submission/current gates remain mandatory before native work; the submitted
capture and native provider/context/source revision identify the execution input.

Fresh native input has no base. Incremental/unchanged input edits a shallow copy
of the retained host tree and parses the captured source, preserving the original
forest's structure/change flags. Source-changing work freshly derives child trees
and maps. Query-only work retains the exact native block/inline/child Tree objects
and included ranges while changing an explicitly registered highlight query; no
parsing/editing occurs in that path. Fresh parser instances avoid reusing a mutable
timed-out continuation. Unsupported asset generations or a missing native binding
produce a failure, not guessed compatibility or a replacement base. The two tested
highlight generations are bundled lexical queries and bundled host queries with
an identifier-only JavaScript query; these are verification registrations, not
new production defaults or a general activation implementation.

Correlate a native reply to the submitted task/capture before evidence intake.
Require exact equality between the native packet and the engine's sole uncontested
retained result before binding its accepted snapshot. Current engine acceptance
and every view read still apply. A result refused by the evidence envelope cannot
be replaced with a smaller different packet and bound to the original tree.
Native syntax observations confer neither edit authority nor semantic truth.

Treat synchronous worker-turn return as separate local quiescence evidence;
cancellation does not itself release the lease or native forest. On process loss,
timeout or transport fault, retain unknown obligations and refuse further session
work; do not manufacture result, quiescence or retirement. Production restart/
reconciliation remains separately specified. Normal cleanup after checks is not
proof of successful engine obligation discharge.

Retirement first fences future borrowing through actual logical kernel retirement.
Keep the native host record counted until an acknowledged drop removes its handle.
Reject duplicate concurrent drop with retirement-pending; do not release twice.
Closing refuses retained/pending work and fences new native submissions before
awaiting close. A normal observed process exit alone reports closed. Failed native
release remains an explicit host obligation, not a restored live snapshot or an
assertion that memory was reclaimed.

[Live native evidence](formal/native-analysis.md) covers fourteen mixed-source
cases, fifteen controls, eleven protocol scenarios and fourteen semantic mutants,
including actual publication journals/copy edits, query-only forest identity,
cross-session refusal, packet binding, current/shared-view release and close/drop
await races. It is serialized native reference composition, not concurrent native
ownership, physical reclamation, native halting, incremental child reuse, real
policy/authentication, full invocation/events/companions or production refinement.
The private bounded pipe protocol and its Python process are verification tools,
not a production API/topology/network selection. INS-09/02/07/01/05/03/08/10/11
cover assets/capture/lease/native execute/packet match/current delivery/retirement
and later presentation. MELT/golden/RED/USE include pending native holds, missing
quiescence/session faults and useful delivery; STRIDE/LINDDUN exclude content/
identity/handle/path/hash metric tags and protect correlation evidence.

### 18.8.1 Half-open analysis query intersections

For the existing supported-analysis query, an authorized current empty source
range [a,a) succeeds with an empty captures array. It is not a point query and
does not synthesize a zero-width capture. It still requires the original accepted
snapshot, actual current view/context/authority, scalar-byte boundaries and
query/reply capacity. An empty request cannot bypass validation or turn a denied,
stale or malformed request into a successful empty result.

For a valid query [a,b) and accepted positive capture [x,y), emit the clipped
capture [max(a,x),min(b,y)) exactly when a<b, x<b and a<y. Every emitted span is
positive and contained in both intervals. Boundary-only contact emits nothing.
The operation preserves source, view, owner, lease and retained-evidence state;
it neither parses nor lowers an edit target. Evidence-summary behavior is unchanged.

The existing analysis reference checks all scalar positions and adjacent scalar
ranges across fourteen pinned native mixed-language fixtures: 872 empty queries,
858 adjacent-range queries and four UTF-8 interior refusals. Eighty-eight controls
and 21 semantic mutants retain the prior admission/currentness/lifetime corpus.
Four SMT conditions prove the integer interval relation, containment and empty
case under the stated range assumptions, with the old [3,3)/[2,7) defect as a
satisfiable negative control. This does not prove parser truth, production
arithmetic refinement, physical accounting or whole-engine completeness.

INS-05/03 distinguish successful zero-fragment release from unavailable, denied
or stale release; INS-08 retains bounded work/retention observations. Count query
traffic independently of capture count and include validation/clipping in useful
delivery timing. Do not expose source bytes, range endpoints or document/view
identities as metric labels. No new instrumentation pathway or public verb is
introduced. Full frozen qualification and endpoint adoption remain required.

### 18.8.2 Closed existing analysis query values

Guard the existing F08 reply forms without adding a release or request route.
Unavailable contains only status. supported-analysis returns captures, context,
parse state and coverage; supplied-evidence-inspection returns the corresponding
analysis-summary without captures. Preserve the exact context and independent
closed parse-state/coverage alternatives. Native producer-compatible nonnegative
safe revisions, generations and identity incarnations do not define a new global
integer or interchange profile.

Capture lists and tuples are dense and closed. Each tuple has an existing layer,
a lossless UTF-8 tag (possibly empty), and positive ordered byte endpoints.
Adjacent captures remain legal; zero-width, overlapping, backward, sparse,
extra-field and accessor forms refuse. Original snapshot ownership, current
authority/view/source/context, actual packet truth and requested-range correlation
remain native conditions, not consequences of shape acceptance. Copying a result
does not copy permission to obtain it.

The actual analysis owner reserves two declared construction-sized logical frames
against its remaining maxHeldBytes before inspecting a query's input/facts. Each
frame is maxEnvelopeBytes plus the larger serialized status-only header for the
two success alternatives. The accepted packet bounds context, parse state, coverage
and all original tuples. Ordered nonoverlapping spans allow at most one increased
lower endpoint; its possible decimal-width growth is bounded by the decimal width
of source length, which the omitted source byte array more than funds. Decreasing
upper endpoints cannot expand their encoding. Dropping source/regions and adding
the status header therefore fits
one construction frame even when maxReplyBytes is zero. The latter remains the
delivery ceiling, not a bound on an as-yet unmeasured result. Safe arithmetic
and complete headroom precede borrowing. One serialized query holds the borrow;
reentrant query, admission, submission, acceptance, evidence/control mutation and
retirement on that owner refuse until completion. These are normalized reply/work
units, not JavaScript descriptor/heap peaks or a global reservation theorem.

Check the actual bounded reply with the existing value validator before release,
and correlate context, parse state and coverage with its original accepted packet.
Ordinary authority/alias/range/capacity refusal is unavailable without faulting the
owner. Unexpected query exceptions or produced-result invariant failures fence
that analysis owner: new work admission/submission/acceptance and queries refuse.
They do not mark source, the editing domain or the provider's retained evidence
as failed. Previously delivered values keep their as-observed meaning.

Every ordinary/fault exit refunds only the temporary query frames and clears busy.
The fault fence is absorbing for that owner. Original tasks, spent origins, leases,
snapshot provenance and provider obligations remain; after the call, protected
cancel/supersede, late authentic evidence/quiescence and justified retirement remain
available. No automatic restart/replay, forced native release, false quiescence or
refund of another obligation is inferred. Actual service, truthful host facts,
global/base-bookkeeping allocation and physical lifetime remain separate gates.

The [bounded value evidence](formal/analysis-query-values.md) covers native replies,
producer-compatible structural boundaries, malformed values and pure checker
mutations. These frames are prebounded; descriptor enumeration is not hostile
proxy isolation or physical/global workspace accounting. The added actual-owner
guard has five controls, ten produced-result/exception faults, seven reentry
cases, three exact headroom cases and eight semantic mutations. The original
88-control producer and 2,189-case value corpus retain their scoped claims.
No public codec, discovery profile, query or presentation behavior is selected.
IF-02 and INS-03/05/08 retain content-safe release/refusal/fault/resource observation
obligations without a new pathway. Full frozen qualification, endpoint adoption
and complete product/implementation/host/measurement/independent gates remain.

### 18.8.3 Actual engine analysis owner binding

The fixed native analysis assembly binds one nonrenewing analysis registry to an
actual healthy engine domain. Existing request/query/evidence products and
internal parser ownership remain unchanged. The selected native ports obtain the
current authoritative root; direct lower-level calls on the same bound owner
must reject caller copies, foreign roots and old root pointers. Equal bytes or
equal JSON are not current-root identity. An unrelated committed annotation
change can preserve current analysis, while a source/context change makes old
derived results unavailable under the existing applicability checks.

Opening requires strict current owner/resource/preparation facts and an explicit
supported analysis inventory, with exact context rows, identities, generations
and the selected language profile. Missing or malformed inventory refuses before
binding the domain; it is not synthesized as enabled or empty. An explicit empty
inventory can own the registry but cannot authorize an unknown context. Recheck
the supported inventory on ordinary current-root calls. A second factory call
cannot reset task/origin lifetime issuance within that domain.

Native admission, submission, acceptance and query require exact-true applicable
grants and healthy current-root ownership. A domain fault fences those ordinary
paths, not independently authorized late evidence, stop or retirement. Those
protected paths require strict producer/control/discharge facts and retain the
existing task identity, two-witness cap, parser lease and dependent-base rules.
No native parser, provider callback, source publication or effect is invoked by
the four fixed current-root ports themselves.

The normalized unbound owner remains a legacy/reference composition surface,
not an alternative way to bypass the bound owner. This binding alone does not
establish package visibility against arbitrary in-process code, a hostile codec,
arbitrary audience/context acquisition, F16 activation, original-invocation matching
retry, F24/F28 products/events or a complete engine facade. Section 18.8.4 binds
the selected existing-owner F08 queries. Section 17.4.2 supplies selected declared
parent/child attachment funding; global/physical accounting and native parser/host
truth remain separate. First-party current facts and serialized inert inputs
remain premises.

[Scoped evidence](formal/analysis-owner-binding.md) covers ten controls, 117 strict
ordinary and 36 protected cases, twelve coherent semantic mutants and adjacent
analysis/native/query/cold-entry regressions. Reuse IF-01/02/05/07, PATH-07/08 and
INS-01/02/03/05/08/12/13 to distinguish optional-profile refusal, ordinary binding
refusal, stale applicability, native owner fault and retained evidence/discharge.
Do not expose opaque owners, task handles, provider identities or source as metric
labels. Full frozen qualification and endpoint adoption remain required.

### 18.8.4 Existing-owner analysis query facade

Bind F08 supported-analysis and supplied-evidence-inspection to the actual
analysis owner through both existing typed and dynamic forms. Preserve
analysis-query/1, family identity, operation/variant agreement and version refusal.
The existing fields remain contract, operation, snapshot and view, plus range
only for supported-analysis. No query creates a task, submits provider work,
accepts new evidence, refreshes a snapshot or publishes authored state.

Capture the caller's complete original domain context and require its equality
with that owner's actual domain context. This binds authority, engine, recipient,
purpose, destination, profile and continuity; equality is not authorization.
Independently require the native current-release facts. Preserve the original
opaque snapshot without traversing or JSON-cloning it. Before native request
sizing, require that exact snapshot to belong to the selected actual analysis
owner. A discovery selector, copied snapshot description or another owner's
snapshot cannot substitute. View identity, actual attachment, source/provider/
analysis generations, range ordering/extent, scalar boundaries and reply limits
remain native checks. Successful empty delivery still follows those checks.

Use the existing finite byte/node/depth argument-capture convention. Reject extra
fields, wrong roles, unsupported versions, ordinary accessors, cycles and
unsupported data prototypes without invoking ordinary getters. Capture current
facts independently of request/context data. These are bounded inert host frames,
not hostile-Proxy containment, an unbounded JavaScript ingress guarantee or a
serialized opaque-reference codec.

Let H be already held analysis-owner logical units, C its maxHeldBytes ceiling,
K the fixed serialized three-limit classification frame at safe-integer maxima,
and B the smaller of caller maxRequestBytes and owner maxQueryBytes. Reserve K
before inspecting caller limits, then seven construction-sized logical frames
before request/context/fact capture. Refuse unless Q = K + 7 × B fits C − H under
safe arithmetic. These frames cover the selected limits, copied envelope,
context, canonical record, current facts, restored producer request and actual
context-comparison values. Preloaded declarations and descriptor/allocator
bookkeeping are not a physical allocation theorem.

Hold Q throughout native query construction and release. Its existing separate
two-frame reservation W (§18.8.2) must fit C − H − Q; it cannot borrow or replace
the decoder reservation. Thus accepted construction preserves H + Q + W ≤ C.
Serialized busy ownership excludes query and owner mutation/control/retirement
reentry during capture. The private handoff to the existing native query runs
only captured inert data, with no caller callback or yield between busy guards.
Each cleanup returns only its actual temporary borrow once, releasing busy on
ordinary/fault exit. Neither refunds retained tasks, bases, leases or spent
origins. Unexpected capture/query faults fence the analysis owner, not the editing
domain or provider evidence. After cleanup, protected stop, authentic late
evidence/quiescence and justified retirement retain their existing guards.

Use handler-owned declarations in the existing accepted-registry F01 route.
No builtin discovery profile is widened. The selected field descriptions and
descriptive JSON Schema share the native query declaration; they describe inner
request shape, not an RPC envelope, opaque identity or current permission.
Standard schema validation belongs to verification/consumers, not a new schema
evaluator or remote loader in the engine. Accepted-registry/schema attestations,
current visibility and original discovery capture remain independent premises.
Initially withheld metadata stays outside the captured ceiling; known subsequent
projection loss invalidates the old discovery context. Positive advice does not
authorize F08. Unsupported/unadvertised capabilities cannot be synthesized from
the presence of a description.

These synchronous queries return the existing immediate captures, analysis-summary
or unavailable value. They require no retained command receipt, authored publication
event or U01 result-retrieval choice. Their producer task, accepted snapshot,
evidence and quiescence remain separately owned. Compatible F16 activation,
F24/F28 original-invocation/retry/evidence/event binding, other advertised provider
profiles and production/host/measurement/independent gates are not closed here.

The [analysis reference](formal/analysis-work.md) records the selected composition,
exact-boundary/reentry cases, standard-schema/runtime distinctions, sensitivity
and selected substrate probes. IF-01/02/05/07, PATH-07/08 and
INS-01/02/03/05/08/12/13 retain admission/capture, current delivery, resource pressure,
fault and protected-discharge attribution. Measure useful deliveries and empty
success separately from withheld/stale/unavailable calls; do not label ordinary
metrics with source, tags, ranges, contexts, snapshots, provider IDs or schemas.
Finite profile walks and a closed two-form dispatch establish only conditional
finite call work, not provider wall-clock termination or whole-system categorical
closure. Full frozen qualification and exact endpoint adoption remain required.

## 19. Views, layout and navigation

Derived from requirements 8–8.1; layout is an optional adapter-facing service,
not part of the authoritative object kernel. Both required frontends still need
their applicable provider integrations. A view owns selections, viewport and
display preferences independently of other views of the same source. Source
state, authored annotations and history are not owned by the painted view.

The view contract supports soft wrapping and horizontal/vertical scrolling under
the declared glyph/cell/tab/combining-width profile. It supports semantic decoration
inputs for selections/carets, diagnostics, search, annotation indicators and basic
inline/gutter content. Matching-bracket decoration is an example of a producer,
not a mandate for a new semantic analysis engine. Decoration order/clipping/style
and virtual hits require explicit profiles; D28/D34 retain their concrete choices.

### 19.1 One accepted geometry context

The logical command layer owns source-byte coordinates and validated mutation.
Shared policy supplies wrap/tab/continuation preferences, scroll intent,
logical/visual command choice and decoration/projection policy. The geometry
provider supplies measurement, shaping/fallback, bidi ordering, fitted rows and
source mappings within its advertised profile. These form one coordinated
computation; no second approximate measurement may authorize an edit target.

An accepted layout context identifies document/view incarnations, source
revision, relevant annotation/decoration/projection generations, configuration,
dimensions/scale and font or terminal-width profile. Painting, caret stops,
selection geometry, hits, visual movement, IME candidate rectangles and native
accessibility geometry use compatible accepted context. Results for another view
or obsolete context cannot be installed as current geometry. Recompute, validate
a declared remapping, or report unavailable; never guess a source target.

Logical source order is unchanged by wrapping, bidi, glyph clusters, virtual
content or control escaping. Programmatic exact-byte edits retain their declared
boundaries. Logical character navigation/deletion uses the pinned grapheme
profile, not glyph clusters. UAX #29 segmentation, UAX #14 break opportunities and
UAX #9 ordering are separate profile inputs; version/tailoring and permitted
higher-level protocols remain D27, not inferred from a dependency name.

### 19.2 Mapping and movement domains

Conversions return valid source targets with any required affinity, an explicit
ambiguous result, a virtual-content target, or unavailable geometry. They do not
promise a universal byte/screen bijection. Define inverse laws only over the
supported equivalence/affinity domain. Decorations cannot enlarge editable ranges
or turn virtual indicators into source bytes. A contiguous logical selection may
paint as several fragments without becoming a disjoint or rectangular edit.

Commands distinguish logical previous/next grapheme and logical line from visual
left/right, visual row and page. Shared logical movement and declared supported
visual-row behavior are required. Full visual bidi movement requires reliable
provider caret order/affinity. Bindings select named semantics rather than changing
their meaning per frontend. Vertical movement retains preferred visual position
only within compatible layout and resolves to valid source caret stops.

Graphical profiles account for supported proportional fonts, combining text and
shaping. Terminal profiles declare cell widths, tabs, emoji/ambiguous-width and
bidi responsibility for the actual terminal/backend combination. Do not reorder
twice or claim exact geometry for unknown terminal behavior. Unsupported runs use
a named safe projection/fallback or unavailable geometry while preserving source
and logical navigation. Source-code control visibility is host-selectable, not a
forced prose policy or something activated by an embedded-language label. D28
records the reference provider/profile and fallback choices.

### 19.3 Bounded preparation and evidence

Virtualization bounds prepared geometry, not semantic document access. Shaping,
wrapping and bidi can need context beyond the viewport; obtain it within admitted
budgets or expose pending/partial/unavailable coverage. Invalidation may be
conservatively wider when dependency precision is unavailable. Never replace
missing layout with a purported exact hit test. Bound retained snapshots, native
resources, decoration fan-out and propagation work under section 17.

Conformance checks source preservation, valid caret/range domains, context
consistency, supported hit/caret agreement and incremental/fresh equivalence under
the same profile. Use simple independent geometry providers, Unicode fixtures and
actual platform evidence; cross-frontend pixel equality is not the oracle. Existing
context models do not prove shaping, bidi, fonts or terminal behavior.

Observe queueing, measurement, acceptance, reuse, fallback and the presentation
milestones actually visible to the host through INS-10/11 and the pathway contract;
do not emit per-glyph telemetry. STRIDE includes control/bidi spoofing, unsafe
terminal escapes, executable markup and native resource loading. LINDDUN includes
source fragments and annotation relationships exposed by presentation. Rendered
document/decorative content remains data, never terminal control or authority.

### 19.4 Accepted geometry query and visual selection products

geometry-query/1 refines F09's caret-hit-conversion, bounded-layout and
visual-navigation-target. The declared-caret-geometry/1 reference profile consumes
a bounded accepted provider relation, not native measurement in a read query.
Its context binds exact view/document/source bytes/revision, annotation set,
layout/decoration/projection/configuration/metrics/viewport generations, viewport,
unit/profile and positive page distance. Current source/view/viewport, rights,
scope, continuity, capacity, liveness, retention and stop facts must still agree.
Full F25/F28 task ownership/admission and actual measurement remain supplier gates.

Declared contiguous row bands carry scalar-safe source stops/affinity and exact
coordinates. Left/right links are explicit, reciprocal and acyclic; source sort
does not define visual order. Edge and unavailable are distinct. Half-open hit
regions identify source or virtual targets. Conditional unique-source caret/hit
inverses must agree; no universal pixel/source bijection is promised. Missing
prepared caret/hit coverage is unavailable, not an empty complete answer or an
estimated target. Ambiguous hits require explicit matching choices; virtual output
never yields a source selection reference. Bounded layout returns requested
retained rows/edge coverage without incidental global totals.

Visual target queries name an origin, left/right, row-start/end, row-up/down or
page-up/down, positive count, layout-bound horizontal goal and per-step choices.
Row motion preserves the goal through short rows; ties stay ambiguous. Page
distance is an explicit positive amount within captured viewport height in the
declared units, accumulated across counts rather than rounded at each row. Exact
integer intermediates protect distance/tie and page calculations. Unknown coverage
cannot become a document-end clamp; known edges may saturate. No universal overlap
constant, key binding, implicit viewport publication or measurement launch follows.

Owned source targets are cached once per exact query under finite quotas and
revalidated at handoff. visual-selection/1 refines F12 supported-visual-movement
with explicit move-heads, replace-primary or replace-all and extension intent.
Move-heads binds every current head/affinity to its navigation origin; hit choices
can supply explicit replacement targets. Stage all targets and use the actual
set-selection coordinator once. Preserve anchors/primary through normalization;
no source revision/history or source-write grant follows. Changed target viewport
or other geometry context stales preparation; unrelated current viewports survive.

Position/affinity does not represent every visual-caret identity. Queries may
report multiple projections, but the consumer refuses unrepresentable target or
move-head origin pairs rather than calling a visual move unchanged. Richer
visual-caret identity is an explicit integration/refinement gap, not new hidden
presentation state in the symbolic kernel. Bound rows/stops/hits/targets, source/
request/reply/layout bytes, coordinates, total steps and validation work. Reply
caps govern successful data; a minimal unavailable control is separate.

[Geometry evidence](formal/geometry-products.md) checks 2,550 synthetic-grid query/
navigation cases, 128 query and 65,536 selection-publication gate combinations,
87 controls/nineteen mutants. INS-10/11 distinguish accepted geometry/query/target
handoff/publication; INS-01/03/08 retain interpretation/release/resource MELT,
golden/USE/RED and STRIDE/LINDDUN coverage without per-glyph/coordinate labels.
This is scoped reference evidence, not actual shaping/bidi/font/cell-width,
independent assurance, hostile decoding, provider/issuer/policy/retention truth,
F25/F28/viewport/native/replay/outcome/event/all-companion or physical/concurrent
refinement. Point storage, runtime dependencies and host matrix are unchanged.

### 19.4.1 Geometry source reply preinstallation admission

This is presentation-owned F09 reference behavior under §1.1 and the explicit
engine/UI partition, not a new symbolic engine route or dependency.

Before installing a new native geometry source target, require the complete
successful source reply to fit the current reply byte bound. A withheld hit or
navigation reply must not consume a persistent target-cache slot. Stage the
prospective reference/reply, check capacity, then install it under the existing
layout and exact-query key. Preserve the final current reply check and existing
authority, quota, currentness and retirement conditions.

Withholding an already delivered reference does not revoke it, reset a quota or
refund lifetime issuance. Subsequent permitted retrieval retains its original
identity. Refusal before native installation is distinct from a later delivery
failure or owner fault after installation. This adds no public geometry gateway,
query, UI behavior, token encoding or cleanup operation. Local JavaScript staging
does not prove physical allocation or a complete ownership ledger.

[Scoped evidence](formal/geometry-reply-admission.md) covers both source paths,
six independent byte boundaries, repeated withholding, original cached identity,
current denial and retirement, plus three native semantic mutations. Existing
geometry/selection oracles and mutants remain unchanged. IF-06, PATH-09 and
INS-03/10/11/12/13 distinguish preinstallation reply refusal, cache reuse and
quota/currentness/lifetime outcomes without source coordinates or handle labels.
Full frozen qualification, endpoint adoption and broader native/operational/
independent assurance remain required.

### 19.5 Owned viewport intent products

viewport-edit/1 refines F15 scroll and viewport-intent through the bounded
integer-viewport/1 reference profile. Bind explicit view/document incarnations,
source revision, expected owned viewport generation and exact unit/configuration/
metrics/projection context. Missing owned generation/context is not a zero default.
scroll supplies signed integral deltas; viewport-intent explicitly sets a positive
rectangle or reveals an owned accepted-geometry source projection. No selection,
source revision, annotation or undo entry follows from a viewport-only change.

Reveal supplies nearest/start/end/center independently per axis and explicit
nonnegative margins with twice each margin less than its viewport extent. For
origin p, extent e, target band [a,b] and margin m, start is a-m, end b-e+m,
center floor((a+b-e)/2), and nearest clamps p between start and end. Center ignores
margins after validating them. Exact wide intermediates refuse out-of-domain
results; declared signed origins do not infer content extents or native clamping.
These explicit reference choices draw on editor/alignment precedent, not a claim
of native/DOM/writing-mode/animation/snap conformance or measured product defaults.

Reveal retains the accepted stop index, not the first source-equal projection.
Recheck its geometry/context and current release gates at publication. This can
reveal a particular projection without changing selection; it does not invent
the richer visual-caret state absent from F12's position/affinity representation.
Raw scroll/set require no layout and may progress while measurement lags.

Prepare an owned plan; bound request/plan bytes and coordinates. Current authority,
read/write/continuity/liveness/stop/interpretation/companion predicates, limits,
target/source/context and captured viewport signature must still agree. Complete
identity preserves the root without new version capacity. A change publishes once
from the current root, replacing only the target viewport and incrementing its
generation and root publication. Preserve current peer views, selections, source,
annotations and history. Equal-value viewport ABA cannot revive geometry/plans;
safe counter exhaustion refuses. Geometry admission/query authority checks precede
relation traversal; this ordering is not a constant-time privacy proof.

[Viewport evidence](formal/viewport-products.md) checks 648 alignment cases,
512 scroll/65,536 reveal-publication gate combinations, 44 controls/thirteen mutants
through the actual geometry target bridge and intervening selection coordinator.
INS-10/11 separate accepted intent, geometry invalidation, native application and
frame acknowledgment; INS-01/03/08 retain interpretation/release/resource signals.
MELT/golden/USE/RED and STRIDE/LINDDUN apply without coordinate/ID/source labels.
Accepted intent is not a native scroll/paint acknowledgment. F25/F28 admission,
actual policy/provider truth, richer selection identity, hostile decoding,
replay/outcome/event/all-companion and physical/concurrent refinement remain gates.

### 19.6 Owned geometry provider work

geometry-work/1 refines F25's enabled-provider-measurement, with captured-geometry-
work/1 and exact origin operation/effect/attempt, provider incarnation and geometry
context. Bind the actual immutable source and explicit owned viewport/metric
context. Admission and final submission require current authority/disclosure,
continuity/liveness/stop/service/capacity/reservation and geometry dependencies.
Submit at most once; no provider callback runs inside a transition. Do not recycle
an origin triple after retirement. A fresh retry needs its own declared attempt
and current admission, not implicit restart or a reset inherited quota.

Bound tasks, outstanding work, lifetime issuance, captured request/source, receipt
envelopes and aggregate held logical bytes. Reserve capture plus two maximum
receipt-envelope charges before admission and verify that minimal quiescence and
all declared failure envelopes fit. Fixed metadata is count-bounded. These are
declared serialized-byte/count charges, not process/native accounting or a selected
physical ownership mechanism. Staging/handoff/provider execution still require
actual host integration and protected-service evidence.

geometry-work-evidence/1 carries the owned submitted task, exact origin/provider,
and closed result, failure or quiescence variant. Failure reasons are unsupported,
exhausted, cancelled or fault. Authenticity/evidence-service/ingress predicates and
actual correlation precede payload traversal. A bounded receipt is evidence, not
geometry validity or worker discharge. Exact duplicates are idempotent. A second
distinct terminal witness retains both, contests the attempt and retires any issued
layout. A third distinct witness returns evidence-full without accepting it,
replacing the retained pair or fabricating quiescence. This capped store is not
closed under arbitrary receipt union; no whole-state lattice claim follows.

F28 enabled-geometry-result acceptance requires one uncontested result, no cancel/
supersession, current provider identity and exact captured/current source/context.
Use the actual bounded geometry validator and cache one owned accepted layout per
task. Within the owner, a second current layout for the same view refuses until
explicit supersession; accepting a new current context retires stale peer references.
Actual owner binding and inherited host envelopes remain integration obligations,
not permission to create registries to reset quota. Stale/malformed results cannot
install current geometry. Cancellation,
supersession, contradiction and retirement invalidate previously issued layouts/
targets/prepared consumers; revocation is not just a guard on new result lookup.
Source/history/selections/viewports are not published by the worker or acceptance.

Stopping ready work prevents submission and closes its unsent work slot. After
submission, cancellation/supersession stops applicability but retains the work
slot and capture/evidence. Authentic late results remain historical evidence.
Separately attested correlated quiescence releases only the work slot, even when
its delivery precedes result delivery. Retirement additionally requires current
authority, released retention obligations and drained delivery. Then invalidate
remaining layout and remove capture/evidence, not issued-origin history. Actual
attestation, transport drain and retention truth are supplier obligations.

[Geometry work evidence](formal/geometry-work.md) enumerates 32,768 admission/
32,768 dispatch, 256 acceptance and 16 quiescence-intake combinations; the selected
lifecycle oracle reaches closure over 101 states/909 transitions. One hundred
controls/twenty-two mutants include actual F09 query and prepared F15 reveal
revocation. The ledger/frame arguments apply to bounded normalized input and a
serialized trusted owner; they do not prove arbitrary decoding, provider halting,
open-load fairness, categorical completeness or native/physical refinement.
INS-10/01/03/08/04/13 separate capture, submit, evidence, current acceptance,
invalidation, cancellation/quiescence and retirement. MELT/golden/USE/RED plus
STRIDE/LINDDUN use bounded status/budget classes, not source/ID/coordinate labels.
Analysis F24/F28, actual provider/authentication/policy/drain/native truth, complete
companions and full invocation/outcome/event/observer composition remain gates.

## 20. Frontends, native input and accessibility

Derived from requirements 9–9.5. The `iced` adapter is an embeddable widget in the
host's event loop/executor; `ratatui` is an embeddable widget in the caller's frame,
allocated rectangle and terminal capabilities. Neither owns the application.
They translate native events to the shared contract, render accepted view state,
manage focus/scroll/redraw and expose effects/events to the host. Hosts may
override bindings and styling without replacing editing invariants.

### 20.1 Targeted input sessions

Resolve focus-dependent input to explicit document/view incarnations and current
coordinate context before admission. Delayed events never follow new focus.
Separate command keys, committed Unicode text and temporary composition. Text is
not reconstructed from key names; an event consumed by the native input method
does not independently trigger a command binding. All adapters accept committed
Unicode text; terminals do not fabricate preedit capabilities they cannot observe.

Preedit belongs to a view/input session anchored to an incarnation, revision and
replacement range. It can affect temporary layout but not authoritative source,
revision, saved bytes, parser input or history. Only an accepted composition
commit becomes a normal validated replacement and coherent undo group. It targets
the primary selection; secondary selections undergo normal mapping, not duplicate
composition insertion. Empty preedit alone does not prove cancellation.

Independent edits may proceed. Preserve/map a composition target only under
validated identity and expected-content conditions; conflicting edits, disposal
or lost authority cancel/reject it explicitly. Focus changes, undo and conflicting
commands use the cancel-before-command boundary in §28.29, with actual native
ordering still an integration gate. A late commit never
redirects to another view. Native surrounding-text/replacement indices require
checked conversion and recipient disclosure; candidate geometry uses the same
accepted layout as the composing range. Bound text, outstanding sessions and
layout work; test event ordering without requiring a live input method.

### 20.1.1 Primary only accepted commit binding

F11 accepted-composition-commit uses composition-commit/1 and the explicit
primary-composition-replacement/1 profile. Carry the original invocation,
document/view incarnations, source revision, selection generation, literal scalar
text and one exact original-snapshot replacement {lo, hi, expected}. Coordinates
are half-open UTF-8 byte offsets; expected contains the complete replaced bytes.
An accepted surrounding-text range need not equal the primary selection extent.
Unknown fields/versions/profiles refuse without an edit. This is not the ordinary
multi-selection text-insertion profile and must not silently widen that profile.

After validating the original target, derive one replacement. Map secondary and
peer selections normally; collapse the original primary to the end of inserted
text with its original affinity, then apply the existing selection normalization.
Retain original primary identity until this final normalization, even if mapped
selections merge. Stage source, annotation placement, one actual source-history
group and view companions under the shared publication decision. Equal source
bytes alone do not imply a whole-operation no-op or create source history.

The [binding and conditional argument](formal/composition-binding.md) define exact
fields, typed/dynamic agreement, original-domain capture/replay, current authority,
all-attached-view validation, actual owner headroom, native-envelope bounds,
ordinary terminal outcomes, stop and protected cleanup. Generic accepted-registry
metadata can describe the native declaration without assigning a new builtin
discovery profile. No IME/preedit/focus state or provider effect enters the engine.
Full qualification/installation and actual UI/native ordering remain separate gates.

### 20.2 Semantic accessibility

The frontend accessibility adapter composes engine document/view identity,
semantic text, read-only/editable state, logical selection/caret and supported
actions with its own native focus and presentation state, independently of
painted cells. Native accessibility focus is not engine current-target state.
Actions enter ordinary command validation; reads enter recipient-scoped bounded
release. Virtualization must not limit semantic text to the viewport. Supply
validated native coordinate mappings for wrapped and embedded-language source.
Announce committed text/selection/focus consistently and distinguish composition
where the native interface supports it. Coalesce announcements, not every frame
or parse. Status/errors cannot rely on color alone; support host motion/effect
preferences, visible focus, keyboard operation and escape from prompts/chords.

D30 records actual frontend/OS/backend/framework support, native facilities and
fallbacks. Keyboard access is not complete screen-reader support. WCAG-derived
principles are not a native-desktop or cross-platform certification claim.

### 20.3 Adapter conformance and instrumentation

Equivalent requests with identical explicit target/context/authority have shared
editing outcomes across input surfaces. Test stale focus, consumed IME keys,
preedit cancellation/commit, conflicting edits, native range conversion, accessible
range limits and unavailable facilities. Real native evidence supplements
controlled-event tests. Trace admission, commit, layout and observable delivery
separately: redraw or accessibility notification request is not delivered output.
Apply the interface observation/disclosure profiles to native services; surrounding
text, accessibility and preedit are sensitive, not diagnostic payloads. No current
finite model proves native event ordering or assistive technology interoperability.

## 21. Clipboard and text transfer

Derived from requirements 10.1. Internal payloads, system clipboard and platform
selections are different capabilities/destinations. Ordinary deletion does not
export. V1 requires plain Unicode transfer and multi-selection replacement, not
registers, persistent kill rings, rich media or synchronization. Optional bounded
session-local structured payloads preserve fragment boundaries without trusting
external text merely because it equals a previously copied value.

Copy captures an identified snapshot and normalized selections. Base copy/cut
has no implicit whole-line action for empty selections. Internal fragments pair
in document order with targets when counts agree. Plain text inserts in full at
each target, not split on newlines. §28.31 adopts structured mismatch refusal and
an LF separator for plain export; external round trips cannot promise recovery
of internal boundaries. Copy has no source undo group.

Paste captures target incarnations, revision and selections at request time.
Revalidate that target when clipboard data arrives; never use new focus. Changed
revisions may be rejected. Any supported mapping must validate identity and
expected content, not infer that unchanged cursor appearance preserves intent.
One accepted paste publishes an atomic replacement group. Text and bracketed
terminal paste are insertion data, never key replay, prompt syntax or shell input.
Any indentation/newline transformation is an explicit profile. Bound payload,
targets, expansion and outstanding requests; do not silently truncate a complete
paste claim.

System cut has a deliberately non-atomic external/local boundary:

1. Validate disclosure/edit authority and source context; retain the captured
   payload within its admitted limit.
2. Request export to the named clipboard capability; retain its effect identity
   and stated acknowledgment semantics.
3. Only after the required successful export evidence, revalidate source and
   authority and atomically delete the captured ranges as one undo group.

Failed, cancelled or unknown export leaves source intact. Successful export plus
failed source validation reports copied-but-not-cut; it cannot retract disclosure
or delete changed text. Ownership acceptance is not necessarily physical transfer
or durability. D32 chooses actual provider acknowledgment/retention profiles.
Undo of cut/paste changes source only; it never overwrites a later clipboard.
Late results still follow section 17 evidence handling.

Conformance includes late focus changes, mismatched fragments, expansion limits,
copy-only cut failures and late/cancelled outcomes. Observe request/dispatch/ack
and local deletion independently without clipboard content, polling or histories.
STRIDE covers text-as-command injection and forged completions; LINDDUN covers
involuntary export, retention and cross-device linkage. Future remote transport
does not imply authority to access either device's clipboard.

### 21.1 Owned transfer and current local publication products

The integration-owned F22/F23 families use exact `clipboard-transfer/1` requests: copy,
cut-export-stage or paste-request, captured document/view/source/selection context,
invocation/effect origin, named provider/capability/registration and plain or
session-local structured format. Actual closed registrations distinguish system,
platform-selection and session destinations, read/write capability and the declared
provider acknowledgment profile. Profile spelling is not provider truth or a claim
of physical transfer/durability. Full invocation/replay/event composition is separate.

Admission captures normalized selections and immutable verbatim fragments under
bounded rights/resources. Plain export joins with one LF; all-empty copy/cut is
unchanged with no clipboard clearing or whole-line expansion. Copy needs no source/
view write authority. Cut/paste need edit authority. Current full registration and
launch/disclosure rights gate dispatch; paste also revalidates its captured target.
Current named provider release obtains copied bounded export payload, not a raw
source/history root. Plain accepted paste broadcasts the whole literal text; no
key replay, line splitting, normalization or implicit transform is permitted.

Exact bounded authentic receipts correlate owned task/origin/provider/capability
and immutable capture. Separate accepted/known-not-applied result, unknown absence,
quiescence, stop, contested evidence and local publication. Validate shape/attestation
before recording conflict; equal duplicates are idempotent and contradictory known
facts retain capped witnesses. Quiescence releases work, not source-edit authority;
stop prevents unapplied local intent but preserves late accepted facts.

Accepted export permits cut only after renewed exact source/selection/identity,
current registration/rights and full companion/history/resource validation. Accepted
paste similarly lowers all literal replacements into the actual ordinary-edit path.
Publish current source/annotations/all attached views and one history group locally,
or leave the root unchanged. Focus never redirects the captured target. Source or
selection changes reject rather than silently remap. Accepted export plus failed
or stopped local cut remains copied-not-cut, not compensated disclosure or joint
external/local atomicity. Native undo/redo changes source/current views without
replaying clipboard effects. Section 6.4.1 separately checks equal-byte annotation
mapping through this same compound path; other companion profiles remain gates.

Session structure requires an exact owned retained handle from the same live
registry/provider/capability/registration and current release/retention authority;
external equal text, cloned handles and mismatched fragment counts do not qualify.
One capture issues one idempotent handle; retirement invalidates it. Bound tasks,
issuance, payloads, expanded edits, canonical/conflicting evidence and held charges.
Unknown/contested effects cannot retire. An accepted unpublished local intent also
requires publication or explicit stop before retirement; quiescence, drain, retention
and session-reference discharge remain separate. Real host truth is not derived
from these supplied gates. Section 6.5.3 separately composes acknowledged cut/paste
with joint local root/invocation/task disposition; it distinguishes Unchanged and
known refusal, retains unknown obligations, pins tasks and stages before installation.
This does not close full public clipboard admission/dispatch replay or live events.

[Clipboard reference evidence](formal/clipboard-products.md) includes 1,536 admission/
768 dispatch/1,024 publication/128 release decisions, 25 controls/fifteen mutants,
actual source/annotation/view/native undo composition and conditional arguments.
Actual provider acknowledgment/retention/release, all native companions, equal-byte
classification, complete invocation/replay/events, concurrent installation, hostile
decoding, physical/production and independent assurance remain gates. PATH-06/DF-11
and existing INS-04/01/02/03/06/11/13 distinguish external acceptance, local result,
safe release, held capacity and work. No new transport or public family is added.

## 22. Commands, registry and coherent configuration

Derived from requirements 3.3, 4 and 11–11.2. Typed Rust calls and stable dynamic
command identifiers address the same semantic contracts. Key/chord, prompt,
palette, menu, pointer, host, accessibility and extension surfaces are adapters,
not separate editing implementations. This does not require every reference app
to ship every menu or add an automation language/plugin runtime to v1.

### 22.1 Registered closed contracts

Discovery is bounded, versioned and recipient-scoped. Describe permitted command
identifiers, parameter/coordinate domains, context/outcome profiles, required
capabilities and advisory enablement; presentation titles/categories/bindings do
not authorize execution. Inspection cannot load code or dispatch effects.
The metadata model supports human-readable title, optional description,
category/optional aliases, typed or schema-described arguments, advisory state
availability, optional host-overridable bindings and structured execution/failure
information. D33 selects their concrete bounded schema and name-conflict rules;
optional descriptive metadata is not a new operation or authority-bearing field.
Invocation validates current authority and preconditions despite earlier discovery.
Host/agent calls use explicit targets, not accidental current-view focus.

Queries may populate bounded derived caches/accounting without mutating authored
state or becoming external effects. An authoritative snapshot can be current
even while a derived query is pending or stale. Validated external-effect
observations enter their evidence-ingestion contract, not the ordinary new-work
queue where overload shedding could erase required evidence. This command/query
separation requires neither separate databases nor event sourcing.

Each registered operation declares preconditions, possible state/effects,
admissible outcomes, cancellation and limits. Unknown verbs/versions, malformed
requests or missing required capabilities reject before effects. Bounded declarative
plans do not add recursive scripting. Extensions enter via explicit registry
