CMP-01/03/04 and IF-01/03/07 retain admission, current conditions and atomic
publication. INS-01/02/03/08/09/12/13 distinguish historical reference release,
fresh capture, selector validation/loss, preparation, publication/no-op/refusal,
fault fencing and protected discharge. MELT/golden/RED/USE keep queue/service,
pool occupancy and nonrefunding issuance separate. STRIDE/LINDDUN and STPA/FMEA
include identity substitution, stale permission/conditions, premature observation,
false authority promotion and leaked holds. Labels remain bounded reason/profile
codes, never basis handles, native identities, values or source.

### 22.3.2 Frontend declarative keymaps and chord interpretation

Frontend map intents name `map`, `expectedGeneration`, bounded `changes` and
`defaults`. They are not engine F16 settings requests. A binding change names
`sequence` and `action`; a default change
names `prefix` and `action`. Closed actions are bind to an admitted command reference,
block and fallthrough; absent action removes the entry/default. Keys are normalized
profile-bound identities, not a selected OS or terminal encoding. No arbitrary
callback, macro, command string, predicate or recursive remapping is admitted.

Absence permits normal applicable-default/lower lookup. Fallthrough explicitly
bypasses that map's default; block stops lower lookup. Priority is declared, not
registration/open/focus order. Incompatible equal-rank actions or command/prefix
ambiguity reject activation, including masked peer conflicts. Same-node terminal
actions cannot also carry children/defaults. Default lookup is local to the current
prefix node; a consumed prefix cannot backtrack into a shorter lower command.

Lookup emits at most one ordinary command intent with an exact input target/context.
It grants no command/effect authority; actual schema/argument materialization,
dependency and capability checks remain ordinary admission. Provider/derived evidence
is not an input-command binding. Unmatched current input is explicitly unhandled;
it does not cause automatic text insertion or prefix replay. Adapter fallback is
declared separately. IME/preedit input follows §20, not raw-key reconstruction.

Pending chord state binds input-context identity/generation, target, keymap profile
and non-confusable chord identity. Stale events cannot retarget or cancel a newer
chord. Cancel/cutoff must match the pending chord; a late timer from an earlier chord
cannot cancel a new prefix even in the same view. Accepted prefixes grow only below
the finite profile bound; stale callbacks prove no time progress. Actual cutoff
requires the named clock/service profile; no default timeout or modal layout is set.

Stage/compile bounded maps and required command/profile/input-context dependencies
in the frontend layer. UI activation rechecks its current map ownership and exact
dependencies, installs coherent changed maps/compiled tables and fresh affected
input generations, and cancels affected pending chords without replay. This does
not publish engine settings or consume an engine invocation. Preserve unrelated
UI contexts; any command emitted later uses the engine's ordinary current guards.
Complete UI identity preserves pending state and needs no unused UI counter or
old-context retention. Relevant target/context change stales UI preparation;
pending prefix progress alone does not force an old prefix to be restored.

formal/keymap-products.md records finite lookup/chord traces and mutation checks,
including an earlier combined settings fixture. Preserve that evidence under its
actual scope while separating frontend ownership and engine dispatch. Actual UI
identity issuance, native key/IME/clock profiles and UI resource/ownership bounds
remain frontend gates; command/schema truth and actual argument/admission/result
contracts remain engine facade gates. No scripting runtime or new execution mode
is introduced. The ratatui example exercises the UI helper; iced may reuse it
without making that helper an engine dependency.

### 22.3.3 Native resource registration metadata activation

The trusted native owner activates the existing resourceRegistrations and
writeRegistrations metadata atomically, refining IF-07/IF-10 and the registered
source/annotation read and source/annotation writer dependencies. This is neither
provider execution/control nor ownership/binding activation. It adds no public
command ID, native job, transport, callback-registration runtime or numeric default.

The exact private request is {changes}. Each bounded change has table read or
write, action install or remove, provider/resource identities and an explicit
expected {state: absent} or {state: present, generation}. Zero is a valid present
generation, not absence. Install adds configuration containing exactly the selected
existing row product minus provider/resource/generation. Read products are
strict-utf8-one-bom/1 with explicit LF/CRLF/CR insertion convention, or
vellum.annotations/1. Write products retain source-save/1's complete independent
capability fields. Reject unknown/missing fields, malformed/unsupported rows,
duplicate addressed slots or any mismatching member as a whole batch.

Require strict current authorization/scope/continuity/liveness/not-stopped,
registration permission, identity, complete registry coverage, companions,
versions/reply/resources and owner/preparation facts. Validate both explicit
known catalogs and the existing lifecycle/membership/bindings profile before and
after. Bound changes/rows by maxRelations, request by maxRequestBytes and labels
by maxTagBytes; bound the copied result by the actual native maxResultBytes.
Activation records supplied Boolean declarations without promoting unknown identity
or continuity to truth. It does not establish an actual provider capability.

Use one private owner-wide registrationFloor, seeded from maximum known initial
current read/write generation. A changed install uses floor + 1, shared by changed
installs in that batch; unchanged rows keep their stamps. Removal/unchanged success
does not consume a fresh stamp or lower the floor. This avoids per-key tombstones
under the existing serialized native owner, with shared stamp-space exhaustion as
the tradeoff. Overflow refuses; no wrap, recycling, silent incarnation reset or
adoption of unknown/imported registration lifetimes is implied.

An owned certificate binds actual owner/domain/before-root, immutable request/
profile, computed result and clock delta. Preparation changes no root or clock.
At final commit reconstruct the entire candidate/result/clock from current known
metadata and recheck facts, basis, floor, profile/native/reply limits and current
baseline promises. Install one frozen root and floor with consumed certificate
identity. Changed batches advance publication once and change only the two catalog
tables. Unchanged success preserves the exact root pointer and needs no counter
advance. Frame authored source/annotations, owners, bindings, baselines, histories,
views/workspaces, other host metadata, actual producer ledgers/charges and existing
source-publication journals. Reply materialization precedes marker commit; no await
or provider callback intervenes. Physical allocation and concurrency/crash refinement
remain separate.

Return only applied/unchanged and one copied {table, provider, resource, generation}
per requested slot, with null generation for absence. This is a trusted semantic
control result, not a public/wire contract or permission to disclose a global
activity counter. Scoped public references must retain existing privacy and
non-linkability obligations before remote/unprivileged exposure.

Current dependent consumers retain their original full registrations. Changed or
removed rows stale old queued submission/dispatch/activation; they do not rewrite
payloads, bindings or historical baselines. Dispatched receipts and late read
transcripts stay attributable under their original captures. Read descriptor
changes neither coerce write generations nor erase successful historical load
evidence. Existing effect uncertainty, retention pins, origins and promises remain.
Removal is not cancellation, provider shutdown, charge refund, physical revocation,
alias inference, force rebind or proof of producer discharge. Ordinary associations
may remain stale until their separate owning activation/rebind contract succeeds.

The native correspondence boundary is host-established and engine-issued: the
trusted host/substrate establishes the exact catalog row/provider-port/opaque
identity pairing; the engine validates it and issues an immutable opaque binding
retaining the complete original row. The engine does not resolve locators, equate
catalog strings with opaque domains or binary keys, or infer write generations
from read generations. Advertised capabilities do not create native capabilities.
Currentness is checked before admission, dispatch and activation, independently
of static integrity checks needed for historical evidence and protected cleanup.
Existing privileged native-only operations are a distinct profile, not implicit
catalog-backed operations. This policy does not select a wire representation.
For annotation reads, the host correspondence requires an independent annotation
read grant and the annotation profile, not a source-read grant/profile. New capture
release and restoration validate the original read registration; restoration also
requires known identity. Withdrawal leaves already-returned captures and completed
restoration outcomes historical, but cannot authorize a new restoration from an
old package. Native task/intent integrity and original-evidence intake remain
separate from catalog currentness.

The trusted native ordinary-writer profile accepts an engine-issued catalog writer
binding separately from the existing document association and pinned destination
condition. This does not rebind a document. Validate exact native writer/identity,
known identity and the original full current write row before admission, dispatch
and new baseline installation; declaration and actual provider capability must both
permit a requested guarantee. Metadata withdrawal does not erase original write
receipts or an already-installed historical baseline. Task/artifact captures retain
the same binding; native-only reuse cannot silently discard it. These native
entry points do not select a recipient command or wire schema. Owned catalog
source/annotation jobs retain the original complete binding as part of immutable
parent intent and its bounded capture. Bound/unbound or changed full captures do
not match; independently issued identical captures may recover the same original
job. Reauthorized historical recovery needs neither fresh admission facts nor a
current row, and performs no launch, candidate capture or baseline reservation.
Fresh work still checks currentness and all independent native premises.
Catalog own-chain source saves require declared logical continuity, causal receipts
and token nonreuse, plus the existing actual capabilities, causal-chain/epoch/probe/
permission checks and bounded credits. Conditional write and synchronization remain
independent declarations, not inferred stronger isolation.
Catalog source exports/Save-As retain the exact writer capture through source
preparation transfer and task/artifact retention. Extra catalog bytes must fit
before issuance; expected admission refusal retains the existing safe-discard
contract for the owned preparation. Exclusive create, atomic conditional write
and typed causal after-results require their independent declarations and actual
native support. Save As revalidates currentness before local binding activation;
original receipts, historical outcomes and protected reservation release/retirement
remain independent of current row availability.
Catalog annotation exports retain a separately bounded export-owned artifact
envelope sharing immutable payload/snapshot/provenance, without changing the reusable
input. Charge its complete payload/condition/catalog capture before either artifact
or task issuance and release it through the existing task retirement law. An input
already carrying a catalog dependency cannot be reinterpreted under another or no
binding. Captured ordinary-association exports retain the existing separate pair/
baseline publication premises as well as catalog currentness. These native profiles
do not enable a recipient/wire command or a stronger physical storage guarantee.

[Scoped evidence](formal/resource-registration.md) covers 42 stages/126 native
publications, 16,384 fact vectors, 42 strict refusals, twenty-nine controls and thirty
semantic mutants in two exact fifteen-case banks, with baseline and conditional
arguments. No case is removed by partitioning verification jobs. Existing 234 SMT
conditions/fourteen manifests remain. IF-07/IF-10, DAT-09, PATH-01/05/10/12 and
INS-01/02/03/04/08/09/12/13 observe admission/activation, stamp exhaustion, consumer
staleness and retained evidence under MELT/RED/USE/golden and STRIDE/LINDDUN without
identity-valued metric labels. View/workspace/command/provider-callback registration,
public invocation/discovery/result/event products, imported/legacy/multi-registry
or contested recovery, remaining all-profile binding/history transfers, actual
host/provider/package/identity/policy/coverage/retention truth, installed measurement,
global/physical accounting and real concurrency/crash/independent assurance remain.
No whole D20/D28/D33/F17/F20/F21 or all-sections goal closes.

### 22.3.4 Owned native resource registration invocation

Connect §22.3.3's existing exact native resource metadata batch to owned F16
supported-registry activation, not document lifecycle. The private reference
wrapper has exactly contract registration-invocation/1, operation activate-context,
invocation, profile native-resource-registration/1 and request containing the
existing exact {changes}. Add the internal registration job kind; no semantic
family/variant label, public command ID, wire codec, callback or numeric default
is selected. Native rows, expectations, capability declarations and bounds remain
unchanged; reject unknown or stale products before publication.

The passive native Rust envelope uses the same exact five outer fields/constants
and original borrowed invocation role. Its inert request retains exact ordered
table/action/provider/resource/expected/configuration products. Provider/resource
identities and present generations are noncoercing safe naturals, including zero;
absence is a distinct exact shape. Reject duplicate slots, extra/shadow/null fields,
unknown tables/profiles and wrong-table configurations before typed output
allocation. Share the scoped registration configuration vocabulary without
promoting capability declarations. Inert capture and simultaneous inert/typed
logical workspace have explicit independent ceilings. Normalized values carry no
authority; decoded submission checks the original native profile then reuses the
typed invocation handler's actual context/currentness/intent/admission guards.
This native value adapter does not choose a wire parser, opaque-role codec or
globally sponsored caller-ingress budget.

Bind immutable request/profile to actual owner/domain/ticket/reference, with
exclusive registration/relation/lifecycle preparation on an issued slot. Capture
the complete invocation context and ordinary admission facts. At service recheck
literal-true interpretation and exact profile, then use the same native candidate/
certificate against the actual current root and registration floor. An unrelated
edit survives; an unrelated catalog activation may raise the fresh stamp while
same-slot stale expectations refuse. Never install an old prepared root.

Stage candidate, native result and invocation receipt before producer mutation.
Check actual root/promise/outcome/receipt limits, freeze and carry actual source
journals. Final exact stage/plan/owner/domain/ticket/before-root/result/receipt
validation and current native reconstruction govern one synchronous trusted
floor/certificate/root/outcome/receipt/terminal transition. No await, provider
callback or nested publisher intervenes. Applied changes publication once;
validated unchanged keeps the exact root and issues no fresh stamp. Removal
does not lower the floor; owned reinstallation cannot reuse a prior stamp.

Queued stop, stale expectations, incompatible context/profile, capacity/promise
failure or final protocol contradiction cannot partially activate. Preserve
authored data, bindings, historical captures and producer obligations. Withdrawal
is not provider cancellation, quiescence, refund or physical revocation. Replay,
forgetting and retirement never reapply or recycle the clock; retirement forgets
the private plan. Production concurrent/crash atomicity remains separate.

The bounded receipt retains the copied native status/registrations result plus
invocation. Require a captured exact-true registrationHostResultAllowed ceiling,
current exact-true registrationResultReadable/registrationResultContextCurrent/
registrationHostResultAllowed, the complete original context, permitted outcome
summary and ordinary release/result limits. Native owner-wide stamps are not a
safe unprivileged/public encoding. Truthful trusted-host classification is a
supplied premise; scoped public references/discovery/events and non-linkability
must be specified before remote/unprivileged exposure. Withholding a receipt does
not rewrite the outcome or make receipt possession authority.

[formal/registration-invocations.md](formal/registration-invocations.md) records
conditional reduction/frame/nonreuse/halting arguments: 42 stages/1,176
typed-dynamic publications across fourteen forms, 256 admission/135 strict
service/112 release cases, twenty-one controls and 32 mutants in four exact eight-case
banks with baselines. Two named combined-fault mutants remove redundant owned and
native identity checks together. Shared cancellation covers twenty forms/eleven
internal kinds, 5,180 traces/14,520 edges. The thirty direct native registration
mutants, 28 families/87 labels and 234 SMT conditions/fourteen manifests remain.
Existing interfaces/pathways and MELT/RED/USE/golden, STRIDE/LINDDUN owners observe
activation, refusal, retained work and current release without identity/stamp metric
labels. Public encoding/events/discovery, other registry classes, actual host
truth, installed measurement, packages/frontends, physical/global/concurrent/crash
implementation and independent assurance remain gates. No whole family or goal closes.

### 22.3.5 Scoped conditional registration basis authority

§22.2.2 read selectors are not native epochs or mutation preconditions. A separate
native-registration-basis/1 authority supplies the dependency for scoped F16
conditional registration. This is issuance/current-use authority; §22.3.6 separately
supplies its scoped native mutation adapter, not a public/Rust/wire token codec. Existing native candidate and
owned invocation rules remain the only registration publication path.

One issuer belongs to one actual healthy native domain, authority and engine,
retaining copied bounded native profile/limits. Exact scope binds authority,
engine, recipient, purpose, destination, policy, continuity and basis profile.
An exact read/write slot contains complete provider/resource tuples. Validate
the actual current native catalogs before interpreting a missing slot as absence.
No caller-supplied root or F07 selector establishes that fact.

Default-deny issuance and every current inspection/resolution require current
registration and target-slot permission, independent basis permission and explicit
presence/equality-observation permission. Those observations can disclose target
changes even without releasing their fields; metadata visibility, data rights or
raw-result access do not imply them. Require exact-true current authorization,
scope, continuity, liveness, identity, complete registry coverage and resource/
retention/reply/preparation facts, plus current interpretation and exact retained
native-profile meaning. Actual host grant truth remains a premise.

There are two closed condition meanings. Present captures the complete actual
row, including generation zero, and requires exact current row/condition equality.
Existing native generation nonreuse prevents removal/reinstallation from reviving
an old present basis. Absent means no row currently occupies the typed slot; it is
not an absence epoch. Absent → present → absent may satisfy the same basis again.
Neither branch depends on unrelated rows, source changes, global publication or
owner-wide registration floor. A changed target present row invalidates its basis.

Opaque object identity, actual issuer/domain and complete original scope govern
resolution. Copied/foreign/retired handles and issued F07 contexts/selectors do
not resolve. Equal active recapture reuses its handle without spending issuance.
Ordinary capture/inspection frames reveal only status, opaque basis where needed,
present/absent classification and current availability, never native stamps,
tuples, locators or clocks. A basis is not a grant or an effect certificate.

Private first-party resolution additionally requires independent exact-true
host-basis permission and returns only bounded immutable copies of slot, existing
native expected condition and row. It is not an ordinary disclosure endpoint.
The §22.3.6 scoped adapter revalidates current authority/profile and the existing
native expected condition at serialized final publication. This point-in-time
authority return alone does not prove that composition or select a wire codec.

Independent finite limits bound live bases, lifetime issuance, roots/profile,
scopes/tags/slots, retained records, private payloads and replies. The conservative
reservation is maxProfileBytes + maxBases × (2 × maxBasisBytes + maxUseBytes +
2 × maxReplyBytes), with safe arithmetic and maxHeldBytes enforcement. Stage all
capture bounds before map/issuance publication. Protected retirement requires
owner control and retention/delivery discharge, not content/capacity grants or a
healthy domain. It revokes resolution without issuance refund or provider/task/
root discharge. Issuer retirement requires no bases; a spent-domain marker
prevents reopening it to reset the budget.

[formal/registration-bases.md](formal/registration-bases.md) records direct
conditional-update precedent and conditional identity/frame/nonreuse/halting
arguments. Evidence covers 42 stages/252 captures, 131,072 authority vectors,
54 strict-fact cases, 48 selected paired worlds, seventeen controls and 32 mutants
in four exact eight-case banks with passing rewired baselines. One named combined
mutant removes redundant native row/condition fences together. No provider I/O,
new job kind or semantic family/variant is added; 28 families/87 labels, eleven
internal kinds and 234 SMT conditions/fourteen manifests remain unchanged.

Reuse IF-01/03/04/07/08/10, DAT-09, PATH-01/05/10/12 and
INS-01/03/04/08/09/12/13 for capture, current inspection/private resolution,
stale/refused conditions, pressure and protected retirement, distinct from native
activation. MELT/RED/USE/golden and STRIDE/LINDDUN cover those boundaries without
native IDs/stamps/handles as ordinary labels. §22.3.6 separately addresses scoped
native mutation composition/payloads; wire/remote, discovery/events/other registries, actual host truths,
installed telemetry/measurement, packages/apps and physical/global/concurrent/
crash/independent assurance remain gates. No whole F16/D-row or goal closes.

### 22.3.6 Owned scoped conditional registration invocation

Connect actual §22.3.5 bases to the existing §22.3.4 registration job and §22.3.3
native batch. The exact private wrapper is scoped-registration-invocation/1,
operation activate-context, issued invocation reference, profile
scoped-resource-registration/1 and request {changes}. Each change has a basis
index, action install/remove and, for install, the complete existing native
configuration. This adds no patch interpreter, callback, new semantic family/job,
transport or Rust/wire format. Native configuration schema/profile/duplicate-slot
validation remains mandatory; host declarations are not self-certifying facts.

Actual opaque bases are supplied in a separate copied reference array, not cloned
or JSON-decoded as authority. Its length equals the change count and indexes form
a complete nonrepeating permutation. Bases supply table/provider/resource and
explicit native expected condition; scoped changes cannot override those native
identities/stamps. Bind basis scope to invocation authority, engine, recipient,
purpose, destination and continuity. Retain its separate basis profile and policy
under an exact current host scope attestation. Preserve all independent basis,
presence/equality, private resolution, current native mutation and profile facts.
Even an empty batch requires an actual current issuer/profile/scope and before root.

Prepare a normalized native request and immutable scoped/native request/profile/
scope values, retaining actual issuer and copied opaque-reference bindings. Bound
both input and complete retained intent/reference envelopes by maxIntentBytes;
bound rows/changes by existing maxRelations and native request/label profiles.
Repeat preparation returns the same plan only for identical actual bindings and
equal inputs after current validation. Native/scoped and lifecycle/relation plans
cannot reinterpret or share the issued slot.

Both typed and dynamic routes use the same owned registration job. At service,
re-resolve the actual bases against the current root and require the normalized
batch to equal the captured native request, without reinterpreting profile meaning.
At final commit recheck scope, issuer, profile and every condition, then use the
existing native candidate/certificate/floor and common baseline/journal/root/
outcome/receipt boundary. No await, provider I/O or arbitrary callback intervenes.
Present bases reject replacement/ABA; absent bases remain current predicates, not
history epochs. Unrelated valid source/catalog activity need not invalidate them.
Ordinary stale/retired conditions refuse without publication; a contradiction in
stable trusted final facts follows the existing protocol-fault contract.

The scoped receipt is {invocation, status: applied/unchanged, registrations},
with one {basis: submitted index, state: present/absent} per change in change order.
It echoes neither native identity/stamp, configuration, global publication/floor
nor fresh basis authority. The invocation correlation was already issued; this
does not establish all-world identifier noninterference. A subsequent mutation
needs separately authorized bounded basis capture, not a free receipt upgrade.

Capture the scoped result allowance at admission; later grants cannot expand it.
Release needs current common context/outcome-policy gates, all scoped result
permissions and original scope/profile/issuer/root validation. Native raw-host and
scoped endpoints refuse the other plan flavor. Historical receipt release does
not re-test the original row condition: the successful mutation itself can stale
it. Current authority loss can withhold the receipt without rewriting publication.
Forget/retire drops private invocation evidence/holds without retiring shared
bases, refunding issuance or discharging producer work. Protected lifetimes remain
independent; native effects, baseline promises and late evidence retain their owners.

[formal/registration-scoped-invocations.md](formal/registration-scoped-invocations.md)

controls and 32 semantic mutants in four exact eight-case banks with passing
coherent-module-graph baselines. Mutation target validity precedes the kill loop;

Shared cancellation now includes the scoped body: 21 forms/eleven internal kinds,

Reuse IF-01/03/04/07/08/10, DAT-09, PATH-01/05/10/12 and
INS-01/02/03/04/08/09/12/13 for preparation, service/final revalidation, publication,
refusal/fault, scoped receipt handoff, pressure and retirement. MELT/RED/USE/golden

## 23. Outcomes, health and protected observation

Derived from requirements 12–12.8. Typed operation status and current health are
available without MELT collection. Logs, samples and traces are neither the
operation ledger nor persistence receipts, authority decisions or recovery state.
Keep successful/no-op, expected rejection, cancellation/supersession, exhaustion,
service failure and invariant/protocol fault distinguishable. These are semantic
categories under adopted D05, not the final public enum (D05/D33). Invalid document syntax alone
is language data. User presentation, host outcomes and supervisor signals may
disclose different detail but cannot contradict authoritative state.

The backend-neutral observation surface supports metrics (counters, gauges and
histograms), structured milestone events, logs with severity/stable targets/fields,
and causal traces/spans across commands, effects, analysis, layout and observable
presentation. These complementary forms need not emit four records per event.
The host chooses its bridge/backend; published names/units/fields remain stable
within the supported schema profile. Expensive development-only diagnostics are
explicitly enabled rather than imposed on normal embeddings, and still obey
capture, disclosure and resource limits. D36–D39 retain the actual schema and
overhead choices.

### 23.1 Status and recovery

An authorized status identifies the relevant operation/effect and scope, safe
machine-readable reason, known publication/persistence milestones and supported
next actions. A single `retryable` flag or severity is insufficient: retry,
replan, reconcile, optional-service disablement and intervention have distinct
preconditions. A failed save leaves an earlier edit committed; a timeout may
leave write application unknown. Notification/export failure cannot reject a
published edit. Exact retained-status access/expiry follows D03/D09.

Health is a bounded headless capability/service snapshot with freshness and
configured/enabled, available, degraded, disabled or unknown distinctions where
applicable. Optional absence is not automatically a fault. Configuration checks
do not imply live successful probes. Effectful probes need explicit authority
and budget. Missing/stale observation is unknown visibility, not healthy zero
load. Recoverable faults remain scoped; catching an unwind does not establish
mutable-owner integrity or containment of native faults/process abort.

### 23.1.1 Layered outcomes and recipient-safe explanations

D05 is adopted: preserve typed authoritative admission/publication, execution
control, per-effect evidence and observation availability separately, then project
the whole report for its current recipient. A failed save cannot reject a known
committed edit; elapsed wait/cancellation cannot prove nonapplication or effect
quiescence. Withholding an outcome may change what is disclosed, not invent a
different outcome. D03 status expiry/loss stays unavailable or unknown rather
than an inferred rejection. Delivered reports retain their as-observed meaning;
later evidence is accessed as a new currently authorized observation.

Project top-level categories, primary and secondary reasons, participant identity/
detail/counts, correlations, metadata and recovery suggestions together. Where
existence is protected, missing, denied, stale and conflicting protected causes
use a common safe unavailable explanation without leaking the distinction through
another field. Withheld/unavailable counts are not observed zero; a permitted
count states its visible scope, not hidden participant totals. Bounded owner
diagnostics keep truthful accepted causes under their independent access contract,
not a privileged bypass available to every caller or default telemetry.

Apply disclosure rules before selecting explanations. For the same permitted
observed facts, each operation/profile defines a deterministic bounded reason
ordering and any bounded secondary detail. Do not expose first-failing internal
checks, arbitrary policy rule IDs, unfiltered strings or container order. No
universal ranking of rejection, fault and external uncertainty is inferred:
phase-specific reason presentation must preserve actual outcome/control facts.
This does not require collecting every possible cause, extra protected probes,
or equal outcomes across distinct permitted execution schedules. Unknown internal
vocabulary follows the existing protocol-fault contract, not a new dynamic code.

Recovery guidance distinguishes observing/retrying the existing invocation under
its supported dedup lifetime, preparing a fresh proposal, reconciling unresolved
effects and authorized intervention. Any proposed retry needs its actual declared
nonapplication/dedup/idempotency/conditional-effect safety basis, not just an error
reason or generic retryable flag. Guidance and its causal implications are also
projected: omitting a hidden cause cannot leave a revealing action or correlation.
Suggestions do not grant authority, restart stopped work, refresh preconditions
or substitute for provider guarantees; acting on them reenters normal validation.

Queued reports recheck current identity/recipient, policy/lifecycle validity and
their allowed capture ceiling before release. Rich cached/prepared content cannot
bypass narrowing/revocation or be enlarged retroactively for a new recipient.
Observation/capture/export failure cannot rewrite authoritative execution facts.
Bound projection, sorting, secondary details, retention and queue pressure under
existing resource contracts; no unbounded explanation search or callback inside
publication is added. Diagnose disclosure/refusal/loss separately from operation
and effect failures, without private codes, paths, participants or identity-valued
metric labels in default signals.

For fixed recipient profiles and equal permitted facts, protected functional
explanations must be indistinguishable across executions differing only in hidden
facts, except expressly declared operational disclosures. This conditional
noninterference contract is not constant-time behavior or secrecy against shared
memory/resources or the trusted host. D09/D12/D38/D42 retain concrete disclosure
profiles; D23/D33 retain exact products/codes and fault integration. See
formal/outcome-projection.md for finite reference checks, local SMT conditions,
assumptions and remaining refinement. No transport, HTTP status mapping, gRPC
dependency or policy engine is introduced.

### 23.1.2 Native execution observation and bounded waits

The semantic product `execution-observation/1` refines F06's existing four variants.
Common fields are `contract`, `operation`, exact admitted `invocation`, scoped
observation `context` and `profile`. Bounded-observation-wait adds a previously
issued scoped `after` observation reference and finite `budget` under its named
clock/resource profile. Resolve exact invocation/incarnation/generation, not a
current slot occupant. Context/reference issuance and native encoding remain gates;
source/annotation snapshots are not implicitly execution-observation contexts.

| Variant | Available product and boundary |
|---|---|
| status | Permitted pending/terminal control observation/reference and currently releasable retained layered facts where available |
| retained-outcome | Current projected authoritative retained facts; missing/forgotten facts are unavailable, not known nonapplication |
| minimal-control-status | Reserved-capacity minimal control observation/reference, no ordinary rich outcome |
| bounded-observation-wait | Observe a permitted change/terminal state, remain within the admitted wait, or end observation without changing the producer |

isolate arbitrary proxies or prove raw ingress/physical allocation bounds. This
uses the native JavaScript safe-integer domain, not a global integer-width choice.

Actual native getters retain original owner/domain/ticket/context, captured and

### 23.1.11 Native load/save observation and retained evidence

F06 additionally has a closed normalized in-process native-operation profile

### 23.2 Callback-free capture and current release

Engine instrumentation covers its semantic admission/publication, logical state,
query/release, effects/evidence and resource/control boundaries. Native input,
layout, shaping, rendering, accessibility presentation and display-delivery
observations belong to the UI adapters/examples, not engine completion. The
shared editor observation index may retain both ownership classes; it does not
require the headless engine to execute or measure a UI path. Likewise substrate
execution/physical timing requires actual module evidence, not engine inference.

Critical admission/publication/effect/input/layout/render paths may capture only
bounded owned approved primitives, stable codes and local accounting. They invoke
no arbitrary subscriber, filter, formatter, serializer, exporter or unconstrained
destructor and retain no borrowed mutable state/content snapshot for later debug
formatting. Reserve outside the critical transition or use a verified bounded
non-waiting mechanism; a queue's name is not evidence of its allocation/locking
or reclamation behavior.

Optional capture fullness/failure may drop/coalesce records with bounded separate
loss/health accounting. It cannot wait for a sink, expand without bound, consume
required effect capacity or roll back a valid mutation. Publish committed records
consistently with actual publication, not preparation. Preserve milestone/source
time and clock domain separately from enqueue/drain/export observation. Preserve
causal/sequence scope without promising global delivery or an event per transition.

Hosts drain/format/export outside owner mutation guards and renderer critical
sections. Consumers receive immutable currently authorized projections under
section 12. Reactions become new ordinary operations, never mutation reentry.
Switching/off/shutdown has bounded drain/discard semantics; richer/new destinations
cannot retroactively enlarge queued records. No global subscriber, worker, SDK,
network access or final-flush dependency is installed by the library. A host's
blocking UI-thread drain cost remains a host scheduling limitation. Avoid recursive
logging, unbounded exporter retries or sensitive stderr fallback on sink failure.

### 23.2.1 Owned optional diagnostic capture and loss

The bounded-optional-capture/1 reference supplies one selected optional queue per
actual native publication domain, not an installed subscriber, new command family,
exporter or network path. It refines D36–D38; §23.3.1 separately defines engine
measurement semantics without widening this queue. Actual measurement capture and
real critical-path instrumentation remain open. Its full fixed scope includes
authority, engine, recipient, purpose, destination, policy, continuity and profile.

The exact boundary-marker/1 record has schema, one existing INS-01 through INS-13
site and one offered/admitted/completed/rejected/cancelled/discarded milestone.
These 78 combinations are descriptive caller observations, not authoritative
outcomes or proof that a real milestone occurred. No arbitrary strings, content,
paths, host errors, identifiers, timestamps, baggage or extra fields are accepted.
Counts describe diagnostic attempts/records at their named boundary, not engine
traffic, useful outcomes, latency or service-error denominators.

Validate/copy/freeze the record outside publication guards under current collection
permission. Issue bounded single-use opaque preparations local to the owner and
observation generation. Token-only capture inspects/encodes no caller record and
calls no sink, formatter, subscriber, provider or command. On slot or byte pressure,
drop the new optional record without overwriting prior FIFO contents or touching
native root/invocation state. Logical non-waiting behavior is not a proof of actual
allocation, locking, reclamation, scheduling or measured overhead.

Drain separately checks current release/retention/transfer and exact scope plus the
actual generation, outside publication guards. Stage the whole bounded immutable
prefix reply before consuming records or changing drained counts. For an enabled
owner with current authority, release/transfer/reply/size refusal preserves both.
Observed authority loss instead invokes the stop/discard rule below. Drained
means transfer into the authorized local reply, not sink
receipt, transport delivery, persistence, audit completeness or authoritative success.
Current collection and release permissions are independent.

Protected health has separate capacity/current permission and remains usable after
capture off/stop, denied ordinary capture/release or zero optional slots/bytes.
It declares optional-capture coverage, mode, last logical-clock-input validity,
slot/canonical-record-byte occupancy and seven offered/captured/drained/dropped/
invalid/discarded/preparationRefused counters. Offered counts token capture attempts;
preparationRefused separately counts valid markers refused by preparation-slot or
lifetime-issuance pressure, not every denied API call. Every counter carries value
and exactness. Reaching its
finite maximum remains exact; exceeding it saturates and becomes inexact. A zero
maximum with a positive event is inexact zero, not actual zero. Counts never wrap;
zero-increments cannot restore exactness. Health must not recursively capture itself.

Queued records receive positive finite logical retention steps. Valid positive
service ticks decrease age rank or discard expiry; invalid clock facts stop and
discard instead of presenting unknown age as fresh. No milliseconds, actual clock,
suspend or fair-service guarantee is inferred. Protected stop/off discards captured
records with accounting, clears staged values and preserves spent issuance. Reset
requires explicit owner/resources and a remaining generation budget; it creates a
fresh opaque generation and counters. Old generations refuse, and no exact delta
or lossless history is asserted across reset. A spent-domain marker prevents
retirement/recreation from resetting budgets. Current matched-scope authority loss
stops the old generation; regrant alone cannot revive it.

Profile validation independently bounds queue slots/bytes, preparations, lifetime
preparation issuance, generation count, record/context/ordinary/protected reply
sizes, drain count and retention steps. Safe aggregate reservation includes staging
and fits a largest marker reply plus protected worst-case health. Retire only under
explicit owner/retention/delivery discharge. Inert typed producer/control values
remain a premise, not hostile-object decoding or a secure physical-erasure proof.

[Reference and proof evidence](formal/diagnostic-capture.md) covers 42 native frames,
512 preparation/4 capture/64 drain/32 health vectors, all 78 markers, 1,555 action
words/5,910 edges through length four against a separate integer oracle, thirteen
controls and 32 assertion-killed mutations with baseline. Ten local baseline solver
conditions give eight nonvacuous laws and two weakened-rule witnesses. With §23.2.2
the current total is 262 conditions/fourteen manifests including §5.2. PATH-11/12, IF-09, DAT-10 and INS-12/13 retain
MELT/golden/RED/USE and STRIDE/LINDDUN coverage without raw generation/owner IDs as
metric labels. Actual installed placements/milestone truth, richer fields, full
measurement catalog, clocks/host policy, measured/physical/global/concurrent/crash
and independent assurance remain. No whole decision/family or all-sections goal closes.

### 23.2.2 Owned local F26 diagnostic drain gateway

The owned-diagnostic-drain/1 profile connects the existing F26
request-host-facility/authorized-diagnostic-drain variant to the actual §23.2.1
optional queue. It is a CMP-17/IF-09/PATH-11 local host bridge, not a new engine
execution mode/native invocation kind, subscriber, exporter, arbitrary callback
or network path. Queue and gateway scope agree on authority, engine, recipient,
purpose, destination, policy and continuity, with separate named profiles.

Open under actual queue-owner/domain/scope inspection and compatible reservation.
The queue installs one actual consumer binding and blocks retirement while held,
even if supplied discharge flags are true. The gateway reserves that binding and
can release it only after stopped state and all known task/result consumers retire.
Binding reuse cannot reset issuance. Existing direct queue behavior is unchanged
when no gateway is bound; actual known consumers are never treated as absent.

Issue a bounded opaque task with the actual queue generation. Issuance is not
admission. Arguments have exactly contract host-diagnostic-drain/1, task,
generation and positive safe integer limit within the actual queue profile. Typed
reference envelopes have family/variant/version/arguments; dynamic envelopes use
name/variant/version/arguments. The actual catalog decoders and hostRequest router
must select F26 and this exact variant. Fixture labels/indexes are not selected
production IDs, Rust types or a wire format. Unknown versions/fields/facilities,
copied/foreign handles and invalid limits refuse before drain.

Submission binds one immutable generation/limit intent. Same-intent typed/dynamic
retry observes existing work; changed intent refuses. Issued/pending/terminal phases
are distinct and results separately state whether admission occurred. With current
ownership, missing scheduler/resource/interpretation readiness defers without queue
effects. Observed matched-scope authority loss fences the gateway and settles
pending tasks as notPerformed, without stopping the independent capture queue or
changing native source/invocation state.

Task issuance and the first issued-to-pending submission require the actual
domain's ordinary admission to remain open. Each owns the existing serialized
admission section through validation and installation; current-fact reentry
cannot install a fence between those steps, and every exit releases the section.
After fencing, matching retries may compare the already admitted intent without
new issuance or execution. Merely issued tasks cannot become admitted. Previously
admitted service, current result/control release, stop and guarded retirement
remain available under their original contracts; fencing does not erase them.
This is the existing admission-versus-retained-service distinction, not a protected
exception for new diagnostic work or a complete shutdown controller.

An eligible service turn checks actual queue mode/generation and current permission,
then attempts the fixed queue operation at most once. Dispatch refusal or stale
queue settles notPerformed. An accepted empty batch is performed with zero records.
Select the current prefix at service, not an admission-time head lease. Reserve the
actual queue's whole reply bound plus result envelope/protected reply before any
drain. Retain the actual batch and historical remaining flag; reads copy it without
another drain. A changed generation fences old pending work and purges old payload
on authorized ordinary release, not its historical performed fact.

Ordinary result release has separate current scope/class/retention/transfer/resource
checks and needs no owner-control grant. Protected control has separate current
permission/capacity, reports phase/admission and terminal disposition, and includes
no batch. Performed with batch null means no retained releasable payload, not proof
of nonperformance. Protected pending-first stop prevents drain; service-first stop
may release payload but cannot rewrite performed. Unexpected drain exceptions or
malformed/correlation-broken private results settle unknown and fence the optional
bridge, preserve prior terminal knowledge, close other pending work as notPerformed
and never automatically replay. No raw exception text is retained/released.

Finite validated limits bound live tasks, lifetime issuance, scopes/binding/intent,
retained batch, ordinary/protected replies and aggregate logical reservation. Actual
queue limits are inspected, not caller assertions. Stop/payload release do not free
task ownership; pending tasks cannot retire. Issued/terminal retirement requires
explicit owner, retention and delivery facts; gateway/parent discharge remains
separate. Logical charges and sequential atomic steps do not prove physical/global
accounting or concurrent/crash behavior. Service/stop fairness remains a host premise;
queries/readiness refusal/replay do not prove useful completion or whole-engine halt.

[Scoped evidence](formal/diagnostic-drain.md) covers 42 native frames/84 typed-dynamic
drains, 128 open/4,096 issue/4,096 submit vectors, 64 readiness/64 dispatch cases,
512 result/96 control cases, 1,555 action words/5,910 edges through horizon four,
eighteen controls and forty-four semantic mutants with coherent module-graph baselines.
The added cases cover both request routes, original post-fence service/retry/
retirement, exact refusal frames, admission-fact reentry and exception unwinding.
Four added mutants separately remove the two fence checks and serialized sections.
Conditionally on the existing serialized domain and native service contracts,
issuance/first-admission cannot cross the fence boundary, while matching retries
cannot install a new intent. This argument does not establish complete owner
inventory, clock/scheduler service or whole-engine shutdown.
The original queue's 32 mutants remain. Eight diagnostic baseline conditions give
six nonvacuous laws and two weakened-rule witnesses.
MELT/golden/RED/USE and STRIDE/LINDDUN reuse IF-01/08/09, DAT-10, PATH-11/12 and
INS-01/03/04/12/13; task/generation/owner IDs are not ordinary labels. Drain is not
export/transport/durability/audit success or application useful throughput. Actual
host grants/clock/scheduling/retention/milestone truth, installed hooks, complete
F26/F06/events/wire, measurement/physical/global/concurrent/crash/independent gates
remain. No whole family/decision or all-sections goal closes.

### 23.3 Diagnostic schema and measurement contract

Every accepted record schema declares identity, typed fields, provenance, purpose,
sensitivity/scope, size/cardinality, retention and permitted destinations. Validate
allowlists before capture; omit/reject invalid diagnostic fields with safe bounded
accounting, not reflexive serialization or changes to the original operation.
Default fields exclude source/comment/deleted text, selections, clipboard/search,
quoted targets, proposals, paths, raw author claims, configuration values, host
errors, arguments and secrets. Registered custom names can be private strings;
they are not automatically safe dimensions. Debug severity is not a grant.

Approved opaque correlation is restricted event/trace data, not a credential or
metric label. Bound series across reconfiguration, not just concurrent registry
size. Sampling is neither a cardinality nor privacy control. Imported trace/baggage
context has separate untrusted provenance and an explicit bounded allowlist; do
not forward it into files, processes or new sinks implicitly. Hashing predictable
identities/content does not anonymize them. Safely encode each sink's terminal,
markup, newline and delimiter context without treating strings as commands.

Optional richer capture needs a host-established grant for fields/data scope,
purpose, destination, duration and storage limits, including embedded-secret risk.
Expiry/revocation affects new collection and queued release. Release may narrow
but never reconstruct uncaptured fields. Support bundles/application crash reports
follow the same inventory; no automatic files, environments, comment stores or
memory dumps. OS/native dumps and trusted-host inspection remain outside the
library prevention guarantee. D36–D38 finalize concrete schemas and loss policy.

The observation population and endpoints must be explicit:

| Question | Required distinction |
|---|---|
| Latency/duration | Admission wait, queue, service, publication, acknowledgment, persistence and observable presentation; pending/censored ages are not omitted |
| Traffic/rate | Offered, admitted, completed, rejected, coalesced and discarded; logical work versus participants/children/effect attempts/diagnostic records |
| Error | Expected conflicts/denials/cancel/stale/syntax data versus service/fault outcomes; attempt versus final operation and a declared denominator |
| Saturation/USE | Actual constrained queue/slots/bytes/reservations/retention/frame capacity and known host utilization; logical bytes are not physical RSS |
| Useful outcome/SLI | Authorized correct publication, exact captured-save evidence, current accepted analysis and eligible protected service; shedding or fast rejection is not useful throughput |

Use local monotonic durations within one domain, not unsynchronized clock
subtraction. MELT forms, golden signals, RED and USE reuse observations rather
than multiplying counters. D39 defines schema, units, populations, denominators
and phase endpoints before measurement or comparison. Workload-dependent histogram
boundaries, numerical budgets, defaults and service objectives require measured
evidence; their absence does not defer the semantic measurement contract.
Hard authority, atomicity, fidelity and
boundedness never become statistical error budgets or tunable compromises.
Authorized profile tuning is staged configuration with evidence and rollback;
lowered limits cannot erase obligations. Collection alone authorizes no controller.

Development builds and both reference integrations must permit safe bounded
inspection of the golden signals. Benchmark/stress evidence retains comparable
profiles/environments and evaluates latency distributions including tail
percentiles, useful throughput, outcomes and saturation together, not averages
alone. Record measurement coverage/loss and effective configuration; no particular
histogram buckets, percentile objectives or numerical regression threshold is
selected here. D39/D41 supply the supported measurement and workload profiles.

### 23.3.1 Closed engine measurement profile

engine-measurement/1 supplies the exact finite descriptors and logical point
shapes in formal/engine-measurements.json and their interpretation in
formal/engine-measurements.md. It covers engine INS-01–09/12–13, not UI INS-10/11.
The profile adds no command, wire format, exporter, SDK dependency, service or
permission. The existing boundary-marker/1 queue retains its original exact shape;
these richer values require separately supported funded capture, not extra fields
under that old name. Actual installed probes and production conformance remain
implementation/evidence gates.

Each descriptor fixes its quantity, type, unit, population, boundary and finite
dimension tuple. Owned retained provenance binds producer/accounting and disclosure
scope, generation, observation interval/cut, applicable clock facts, continuity
and captured limits. Unknown fields/dimensions refuse the measurement, not the
operation. No document/principal/path/attempt/profile identifier becomes a metric
label. Collection/release requires authority for the entire measured population;
correlation is separately bounded restricted event/trace data, never authority.

Counters are cumulative within one generation, gauges describe a current cut,
and duration observations distinguish completed, pending and censored phases.
Off/unavailable/unknown are not zero; stale or lossy data cannot silently become
fresh exact totals. Nonrefundable work, reusable occupancy and retained commitments
keep distinct tagged units. Same-series continuous exact evidence is required
before deriving a delta; clock-invalid/cross-domain/cross-epoch timing refuses.
Seconds and explicit byte/count units do not choose workload histogram boundaries,
numerical budgets, production limits or SLOs.

Per-offer admission dispositions distinguish replay and pre-admission refusal
from first logical admission. Derived refusals are not necessarily stale or fault.
Effect first-result timing ends once at the first authentic attributed result
observation, not progress/quiescence/duplicate evidence or inferred persistence
success. Baseline-adoption counts measure exact accepted captured-output baselines,
not universal current external freshness. All useful-outcome interpretation keeps
its actual correctness/authority/evidence premises.

formal/engine-measurement-checks.mjs checks the finite declarations, value shapes,
tagged coordinates, bounded counter arithmetic, supplied-continuity delta and
local-clock/first-result predicates with semantic mutations. This is design-value
reference evidence, not installed capture, actual provider classification, runtime
episode tracking, allocator/clock truth or independent certification.

### 23.4 Coverage, threats and verification

The existing observation index and model §11 govern placements across execution,
identity, connections, data flows/assets, interfaces and assumptions. Carry origin
through fan-out/fan-in/coalescing/retry without imposing serialized execution or
one nested span tree. Record host-unobservable facts and non-applicability honestly.
For each material interface retain producer/consumer, ownership/trust, milestone,
clock/count domain, loss/coverage, classification, cost, threat and verification
links. Structural index completeness is not installed runtime coverage.

Apply STRIDE to producer/context spoofing, record/schema tampering, loss/attribution,
disclosure, queue/cardinality/formatting DoS and probes/remediation privilege.
LINDDUN additionally examines linking, identity, involvement, retention, awareness
and unwanted attribution; operational aggregates can disclose activity. Focused
STPA/FMEA examines omitted/unsafe/mistimed/overlong actions in release, publication,
cut, cancellation, save and remediation. Keep prevention/containment separate from
detection and planned injection separate from executed evidence. No numeric risk
score or legal/safety certification is implied.

For the same admitted sequence and controlled external inputs, compare
authoritative transitions/outcomes with capture off, successful, full and failed.
This does not require identical wall-clock schedules or zero overhead. Test slow,
panicking/reentrant consumers/formatters, series floods, delayed records, policy
change before drain and unavailable shutdown sinks. Independent synthetic canaries
cover source/comments/quotes/history/config/arguments/host errors in captured
records as well as exports. PS-AC/PS-PV/PS-UP and related projection checks remain
restricted model evidence; exact covered properties follow formal/slices.md and
the report, not this summary. They do not prove arbitrary schema privacy, queue
implementation safety or open-load fairness.

## 24. Assurance, model feedback and security gates

Derived from requirements 13–15.6. Contracts specify observable inputs, outputs,
effects and assumptions before representation. Material changes update/review
the affected twin before test/production changes, then follow model–test–implement–
refactor with shared behavior scenarios and defect-specific regressions. No
production implementation is established by this drafting pass.

### 24.1 Evidence and composition

For consequential transitions, record pre/postconditions, preserved invariants,
failure/unknown branches, rank/resource argument and environmental supplier.
Classify claims as reviewed reasoning, bounded checking, solver condition,
independently checked theorem/certificate, test, assumed, planned or contradicted.
Current formal assets do not supply all these evidence kinds. A graph link,
shared name, test count or passing local slice is not end-to-end refinement.

The assurance chain is requirement → contract/assumption → possible loss/control
→ scenario/oracle → evidence with artifact/environment identity. Compose only
after establishing shared identity/context/event ordering and pre/postcondition
bridges. Retain counterexamples and deliberate controls that violate the intended
property, not unrelated parser/tool failures. Useful-success and failure/unknown
witnesses prevent reject-all vacuity; existence of a witness is not universal
progress. Static enumeration bounds and transition horizons remain distinct.

Mutation evidence must separate fixture/source construction and module loading
from execution of the semantic oracle. A missing/stale mutation target, setup
assertion, import failure or syntax error is a verifier failure, never a detected
semantic mutant. Preserve each mutation's identity and intended weakened rule
when updating source targets. A coherent unchanged graph must pass first; a
surviving mutant or non-assertion runtime failure must fail the verifier. Cleanup
still applies when graph construction fails.

The selected [harness evidence](formal/mutation-harness.md) moves construction
outside semantic assertion detection in 63 existing harnesses, retains registration
cleanup and repairs three stale targets without changing engine predicates or
mutation identities. Eight control-flow fixtures, four lexical regression controls
and three current-target checks constrain this refinement. Lexical shape checks are
not an AST/control-flow proof of arbitrary harnesses, all mutation cardinalities
or independence. Actual mutant execution and full frozen verification remain
required; no new solver law or whole-engine proof is added.

For each accepted finite execution, every nonterminal processing step consumes
well-founded rank/budget or terminates, including duplicate/invalid event handling,
polls, retries, child work and restart. Reconfiguration cannot refill it implicitly.
Exhaustion stops further control but preserves prior effect evidence. Real-time
progress additionally needs finite/cooperative service and actual deadline
delivery; finite model steps alone are insufficient. Reconciliation is a separately
bounded obligation, not hidden resumption of an exhausted invocation.

Immutable facts scoped to one effect/attempt may form a finite powerset lattice
under subset/union/intersection. Contradictions accumulate provenance for
reconciliation rather than overwrite. Do not merge unrelated attempts or call
all business/control states a bounded complete lattice. Valid execution traces
can form a free category with identity/concatenation on compatible endpoints;
no general limits/colimits, common terminal success/failure or categorical
completeness is claimed. Exact existing mathematical claims remain those in the
formal assets, not additional theorems created by this prose.

### 24.2 Acceptance layers

| Layer | Required oracle and limit |
|---|---|
| Protocol/design | Explicit assumptions, finite domains/horizons, total admitted relation, safety and conditional progress; not implementation conformance |
| Pure core | Independent simple edit/mapping/history expectations, generated/fuzz sequences and minimized synthetic regressions; law preconditions stay explicit |
| Interfaces/pathways | Equivalent public invocation outcomes, typed effects and authoritative state through controlled interleavings, host and both adapters |
| Real integration | Actual filesystem/clipboard/native input/accessibility/terminal/geometry evidence for the named supported profile; simulation is insufficient |
| Adversarial/resources | Delayed/duplicate/reordered/contradictory evidence, stuck work, exhaustion, hostile text/config/assets and observation-off/full/failure |
| Performance/reliability | Representative human and agent workloads, bursts and large/scattered edits with declared environment, exposure/failure unit, tails, censoring and uncertainty |

Deterministic hosts control time, scheduling, task/effect completion, files and
clipboard and permit deliberate interleavings, not only sequential tests.
Thread-crossing ownership/publication/cancellation additionally requires actual
concurrent integration evidence; a stress run is not a race-freedom proof.
Preserve generated seeds and minimized synthetic regressions. Shared BDD scenarios
state observable behavior across promised invocation/adapter paths; helper/tool
choices cannot force downstream consumers to adopt a test runner.

Performance scenarios cover typing, large-file opening, scrolling, parsing,
highlighting and search, retaining comparable golden-signal evidence. State
latency/memory budgets before treating performance claims as acceptance criteria.
Risk-based gates must report known failures, unsupported configurations and native
limitations explicitly, not silently exclude them from success populations.

Comparative evaluation includes Helix, Neovim and GNU Emacs alongside CodeMirror
and VS Code where relevant, with pinned upstream versions/revisions and official
evidence. Compare semantics/assumptions rather than feature counts. Storage
evaluation covers the rope, piece-tree, memline block-tree and gap-buffer designs
identified by requirements §13.3; actual Vellum workloads precede dependency
selection. Normalize intentional differences before differential comparisons;
another editor is not a universal oracle. Material departures record baseline,
agent/user value, complexity/assumptions, failure/recovery and needed evidence.
Preserve explicit targets, bounded atomic changes and simple ordinary APIs rather
than importing implicit focus, key replay or mandatory prompts. This establishes
evaluation obligations, not new upstream research, benchmarks or implementation
selection in this pass.

Safety is not a statistical objective. Zero observed failures is not zero risk.
Independent reviewers/oracles should challenge high-risk assertions; author/reviewer
roles and shared tooling assumptions remain disclosed, without implying separate
organizations or Cleanroom certification. Maintain source/idea/asset/license
provenance. Cleanroom-inspired prevention is not source-isolated reimplementation;
prior upstream inspection cannot be relabeled isolation. Unsafe Rust, if ever
necessary, requires explicit justification, isolation and tests.

D40–D41 finalize risk-tier gates, required review evidence, retention and workload
profiles before release/reliability claims. No hidden requirement to build editor
code, choose storage or run performance experiments is introduced by this pass.

### 24.3 Security and privacy boundary

The embedding host establishes current local access contexts and capabilities;
default capability absence is denial, not ambient authority. Caller labels,
workspace membership, provenance and correlations confer no grants. Validate
untrusted requests, identities, versions, persisted data, geometry, completions,
assets and diagnostic fields at their actual boundaries. Current checks apply
at publication/dispatch/release as required by the owning contracts. Revocation
cannot recall dispatched effects or already disclosed copies.

Document permitted existence/body/history/metadata/aggregate/outbound disclosures
and operational interference, with recipient projections in section 12 and
annotation rules in section 13. Keep source/annotation/cache tokens scoped and
avoid unauthorized hidden counts, graph blockers or gutter/accessibility markers.
Denial masking does not falsify trusted effect evidence. Paired hidden-state
tests protect declared functional outputs, not constant-time/resource privacy.
Raw snapshots already handed to trusted code are disclosures, not revocable
references. No secure erasure from allocator/OS/backups or isolation from malicious
in-process Rust/native code/compromised host is claimed.

For each material boundary maintain asset/adversary/entry/trust assumptions,
applicable STRIDE/LINDDUN threats, prevention, detection, containment, recovery,
residual limits and verification. Explicitly justify non-applicability. Review
changes to boundaries, formats, services, assets or export. Confirmed vulnerabilities
require synthetic regression tests. Optional diagnostics never replace enforcement
or durable audit; no remote identity/policy engine, network listener or federation
is required. D42 resolves any remaining concrete local policy profile rather than
claiming a host sandbox.

The security acceptance matrix covers all applicable STRIDE categories: forged
identities; malformed/stale/reordered/tampered inputs and receipts; attributable
outcomes with honest diagnostic loss; unauthorized disclosure through every
supported read/export surface; bounded hostile text/query/event/resource behavior;
and attempts to gain capabilities through supported extension/provider interfaces.
Use unit, property/fuzz, concurrent, integration and exhaustion evidence as risk
requires, without real secrets in fixtures. Parsing/executing dependencies must
remain reviewable and replaceable under the supported update policy. D47 governs
security reporting, audit cadence and supported fixes, not an invented response
deadline or complete process-compromise protection.

### 24.4 Living twin and reproducibility

Keep model.md canonical for architecture and typed catalogs/pathways, diagrams and
formal links consistent. Mermaid, RDF/SHACL, TLA+ and SMT remain design tools, not
production dependencies. Validate model before test/build gates; preserve tool
versions/hashes, selected configurations, bounds, controls and input identities.
Generated views must be reproducible and contributor-inspectable; never embed
secrets or sensitive deployment data. Structural validation cannot discover every
omitted threat/component or certify semantic suitability.

Contract/counterexample/implementation drift triggers explicit review: correct a
defect or explicitly revise intended behavior, never weaken an invariant merely
to make evidence pass. A design-only change may finish with implementation pending,
but cannot be labeled implemented. Final clause-level dispositions, operation
relations, assumption suppliers and conformance obligations are tracked by the
coverage gate; recommendations and current hash matches alone do not close it.

Material changes include externally observable contracts or moved ownership,
authority/disclosure, dependency, effect, resource or compatibility boundaries;
D48 must finalize the review threshold and lightweight nonmaterial path. Maintain
explicit current/proposed/experimental/deprecated/removed status and the source
of manually authored/generated/checked views, without treating a status label as
runtime evidence. Extend stable traceability to actual clauses/code/tests/evidence;
audit-local paragraph ordinals are not permanent public requirement IDs. Drift or
stale evidence cannot satisfy integration gates. Concrete production schema and
CI/tooling choices remain separate from the selected design validators.

#### 24.4.1 Captured verification input retention

Retain the full-run frozen input snapshot and its report independently of checker
scratch copies. External captures remain retained by default. The verifier may
own a separate disposable capture scope for each check and its descendants.
Release that scope only after the existing process-disposition, expected-role,
output and validation checks pass. Valid expected counterexamples and successful
parents of expected failing descendants release their disposable copies; unexpected
failures and rejected output retain the scope for inspection. Zero exit alone is
not a sufficient release condition.

Use original scope ownership, recorded creation path and directory identity for
cleanup. Copied ownership objects and mutable returned path fields do not grant
deletion authority. Detect directory/symlink replacement at cleanup validation;
this endpoint check is not atomic host containment. Cleanup failure is a
tool failure that demotes a candidate pass, not a semantic counterexample.
Standalone opted-in checkers reclaim their own copies on successful exit; full
verification snapshots explicitly remain outside disposable scopes. Partial
capture ownership survives a handled copy error through final disposition.

Record scope retention state in assurance reports, separate from engine runtime
signals, outcomes and authority. Disk exhaustion invalidates affected qualification
even if other checks pass. This verifier policy adds no engine verb, subsystem or
physical/global resource guarantee. Historical garbage, other scratch files,
retained evidence/failures, abrupt process or host termination, quotas and actual
capacity remain separate obligations. Commands finish dependent work before
reporting results; scope release is not descendant termination or orphan detection.

[Capture retention evidence](formal/capture-retention.md) records seventeen
lifecycle controls, nine mutations and ten registered read-result regressions.
Full frozen verification and endpoint reconciliation remain required; scoped
controls are not independent certification or unbounded lifecycle proof.

## 25. Packaging, compatibility and supported profiles

This section distinguishes engine package contracts from separate substrate and
UI integrations. Both reference adapters/apps remain wider-editor release
obligations, not dependencies or completion prerequisites of the headless engine.
UI framework/native/presentation types remain outside its exported semantic API.

Derived from requirements 3.1, 16–16.2. Separately usable core/coordinator/facade,
language, layout, frontend and app layers expose no framework runtime/types in
the core. Optional integrations must not force unrelated platform/runtime
dependencies. Both reference frontends/apps remain thin consumers of shared
semantics, not copies of the editor. Headless operation needs no UI, parser,
telemetry sink, filesystem or network. D43 names actual crates/features and
supported toolchain/dependency/platform combinations without guessing versions.

Compilation/import/feature enablement does not load assets, download resources,
initialize external services or gain authority. Record redistribution/provenance
for code, grammar/query and test/example assets. V1 provides in-process Rust
contracts, not a stable native plugin ABI. If serialized commands/persistent
formats are exposed, choose their explicit compatibility policy before claiming
support; a future wire protocol is not implied by dynamic command IDs.

A supported behavioral profile names verbs, schemas, capabilities, lifecycle and
semantic/resource/disclosure guarantees. Absent, unsupported and denied remain
distinct within safe projections. Negotiation grants no authority and cannot
silently weaken required guarantees. Registration adds a new validated profile,
not unknown execution semantics. Unknown descriptive metadata is permitted only
where the declared schema proves it cannot alter validation/execution. The user
selected exhaustive authority-bearing executable enums within explicitly versioned
profiles. Known Unknown knowledge/effect states are named finite cases, not an
Unknown(payload) escape for executable extensions. Adding an executable case or
changing its payload meaning requires an explicit profile/API compatibility and
migration decision; do not make a silent same-profile extension. This applies to
executable operation/control/outcome vocabulary, not arbitrary descriptive metadata.
The existing finite catalog and unknown-variant checks establish the conditional
closed-domain argument; actual Rust construction/matching and downstream compile
conformance await the implemented API under E01.

Compatible evolution preserves observable contracts under the same assumptions:
do not strengthen caller obligations or weaken promised outcomes/safety/progress.
Internal steps and allowed nondeterminism need not have identical traces.
Coordinates, Unicode/matching, defaults, selection/history, ordering, acknowledgment,
failure classes and resource ceilings are behavior, even when types compile.
Security restrictions may be necessary but cannot be mislabeled transparent.
Adapters require evidence of semantic preservation, not weaker emulation under an
old guarantee name. Retained work follows section 22 generation/contract rules.

Compatibility evidence combines downstream compile checks, shared scenarios and
high-risk model/contract review across declared feature combinations. D44 selects
version/deprecation/support/security-update and migration policy; no indefinite
compatibility, arbitrary dependency composition or stable Rust ABI is promised.
Preserve observation milestone meaning without requiring identical span topology
or diagnostic counts. Storage backend choice remains an implementation evaluation
between established candidates, not a dependency selected by this specification.

V1 needs one backend behind small engine-owned source/snapshot interfaces, not a
general runtime-pluggable storage framework. This is the in-memory text backend, not
the modular resource substrates of §1.2. The local filesystem substrate is a
separately wired first target, not a dependency of this text representation.
The module map exposes engine-owned resource/effect/identity products at that
boundary; OS/SDK handles, credentials and concrete procedure types remain inside
their module. Other substrates need declared profiles and evidence before support.
Physical chunk IDs are not stable document/anchor/block/token identities.
Content and coordinate laws must hold
across chunk boundaries, including CRLF, graphemes and search matches. Retention
accounting includes deleted text, staging, history and reclamation work; cheap
snapshot cloning guarantees neither indefinite cheap retention nor bounded
destruction latency. Whole-document materialization is explicit and budgeted.
Storage capacity and optional parser/layout degradation have separate profiles,
so unsupported analysis on a long line cannot corrupt accepted source. D06/D43
retain actual limits/representation/evaluation choices.

## 26. Logical editing and supplied semantic evidence

This final traversal section refines requirements 3.4.2, 5–5.3.1 and the adopted
ideas in 19.9; section order does not imply execution order or priority. The
canonical publication path in sections 1–9 remains shared by every operation.

### 26.1 Coordinates, selection and ordinary commands

Indexed immutable UTF-8 source access supplies bounded range/line reads and
batch edits without requiring full materialization; actual storage and physical
retention refinement remain unselected. Coordinates always name their unit,
incarnation and revision/context. Convert bytes, lines, scalar/UTF-16 native
indices, parser points, logical graphemes and display positions explicitly;
invalid, ambiguous or unsupported conversion is not rounding permission. Line
spans/anchors resolve to canonical source ranges. Parser nodes are contextual,
not durable identities; tokenizer tokens are not coordinates.

One or more selections preserve direction and explicit primary identity. Human
selection commands and agent target sets use the same source-change semantics;
programmatic targets need not create cursors. Navigation/extension resolves
character, word, line, page and document operations under declared profiles.
Character navigation/deletion uses logical graphemes, with visual movement in
section 19. D45 must define word/line/end-of-document, selection normalization,
primary/direction and indentation/tab command behavior; no reference editor's
entire modal/binding scheme is silently imported. Newline awareness follows
section 16, not normalized storage. Read-only and operation-scope checks apply
equally to ordinary edits, replace, undo and composition.
