before accepting a complete snapshot; partial records cannot be published. Real
parser/allocation cost and retained ownership need implementation evidence.

Staging captures current document incarnation/source and annotation-set dependency,
owns an immutable candidate and changes no managed state. Restoring serialized
identity/version values requires independently established continuity and registry/
history compatibility; they are never accepted as current edit preconditions merely
because a file contains them. Do not resurrect a retired incarnation, roll a live
counter backward or overwrite a concurrent comment. Any supported load/replacement
names its complete affected set and revalidates current annotation-set/history,
identity, source, authority and resource dependencies at the shared atomic boundary.
An empty imported snapshot does not implicitly authorize deleting live comments.

Version 1 performs no implicit migration, merge or reidentification. Unsupported
formats/versions preserve both the input and current state. A future explicit
migration/import contract must stage and validate its complete consequences before
publication; selecting version 1 creates no promise to interpret unknown versions.
Host binding/location, actual identity/source truth, load/publication implementation,
full history/retention and physical persistence remain separate obligations.
formal/annotation-snapshot.md records the argument and scoped checks.

### 29.5 Pinned assets and supported integrations

The reference host uses a bundled immutable pinned Markdown grammar/query set
and at least one pinned supported child grammar/query integration. Selection is
recorded with provenance, licenses and compatibility versions. Host-supplied
alternatives are admitted as complete validated contexts; none are fetched just
because a fence or schema names them. Existing last-known-good/plaintext failure
rules apply. Mermaid fallback must be truthful and never implies rendering.
Section 18.6 now pins and executes a native block/inline/JavaScript child reference.
Production package/ABI/bundling/license and required frontend integration remain
release work, not inferred from that tool set or a broad grammar-distribution promise.

Keep the authoritative core dependency-minimal, with optional provider and frontend
adapters separate and both thin iced/ratatui reference apps. Use a narrow explicitly
named and tested reference support matrix, not a blanket all-platform guarantee.
No required adapter, keyboard/semantic capability or host-child integration is
waived by this default. Crate/version/MSRV/feature/license selection and actual
native accessibility/IME/clipboard/geometry evidence still require concrete review.

### 29.6 Observation and evidence

Default diagnostics contain no authored content, private locators or unbounded
identity labels. Capture is bounded/nonblocking with explicit loss/freshness;
drain/export is optional, separately authorized and outside editing publication.
Keep metrics adapter-compatible with OpenTelemetry's measurement model without
requiring an exporter, global subscriber or ecosystem type in the core API.
MELT/golden/RED/USE share populations and units; privacy/threat/failure lenses
remain in §23. Selecting the default does not prove cost or installed coverage.

Hard finite resource profiles remain mandatory. A provisional configurable limit
can support development only when its unit, refusal behavior and unvalidated
status are explicit. Production reference defaults and service/reliability claims
need measured workloads, actual ownership/charging, clocks and confidence/loss
information. No numerical value is supplied by convention alone. Real security
contacts, fix/support commitments and acceptance roles require accountable owners.
These are evidence/ownership gates, not defaults that a proof model can invent.

formal/reference-profile.md records precedents, conditional arguments, executable
scope and remaining obligations. Neither these selections nor their finite checks
establish whole-engine categorical completeness or implementation refinement.
